Dimbri (Drama) 13. JugiSildii (Drama) AGANSOANI A 'chikkuo Sea-Jotani a'bao kolgapatna nangbeenggipa bak mingsara Dakmesokani. NEHU Tura Campusko kuliantal, songsarni golpoko segiparang bewalan nakatdapjok. Indiba Dakmesokaniko segiparang nangnikani kri baridapjaenga. Dakmesokaniko poraie gisik an senganiko u idapaniko man a. Indiba sa-attalo Dakmesokanirang an chingo dongsrangja gitan ong'aienga. Dongna gitaba maiko dakmesokgen? Segimin Dakmesokanirang bang'gijanian iani mingsa ja pang neng nikani ong-a. Indake ong-engo, Pa Prabodh M. Sangmani segimin "Dimbri Matgrlk” Dakmesokaniara balwa gital balnapbaa gita ong'a. “Dimbri Matgrlk* aganronggimal mite paksa, mande pil-sa ingipa gitan, Maambi pilsa ongna krakra banaidapani paksa daka. Bak ra-giparang ba Dakmesokanio Kal giparang mitama Maambio dongmanchagiprangan; mitamrangara banaidapgiparang.

A'chik Me*chik Dimbrina mai ong-chongmotachim, uko talsrange serikani dongja aro obosta chong-motko u*ina ja kol like ja*kol sane niachi tikkelaniba komia. landaka jajaarangni gisepo, Pa Prabodh M. Sangma an*tangni ong*na kranikgipako Ma'ambiming meliate ia Dakmesokaniko sea. Senokgipa an-tangan uni Aganchenganio Dimbrina ong'a a'selko chanchiatang p] gita dingtange ra-a aro Dimbriko A-chik Matgrik gita mesokna jotton ka a ine janapa. Me'chikrangna Bil-Jak on*na a gilsak gimikon tikkelmiting chachaon, me chikrangko skotong done, me-chikni gun-mikkimko golponi ja'pang bisring ra e Dakmesokaniko seaniara, A-chik me*chikrangna rasong chaani ong-a. A chikrangni Tibetoni katbamitingo, Achik me-bhikrang ramaoba nokdangni kam- bewalko ja rikkue, setangtangni bobil dingao dingpae, A-chikni ma-kringko mangkimaatjana jak on-paa baksana, A-chik me-chikni gun-mikkimko de-doaha. Ma-ambiko gualangenggipa, una gisik on-ani komienggiparangna ia Dakmesokani ding-chaoatani ong-chongmota. A-chikrangni skango janggi tangani, kam-bewal aro bebera-anirangko chasong gitalni Senokgiparangko

seachi ripinge donna ia ki-tap didiatgen ine ka-donga. Ia Dakmesokanio on-gipa ja-pang golpoko darang Ma-ambiko See Rakkianioba poraiman-jawa. Bisring dingsa man-akosa, Pa Sangma dokbadale on-jotdape sea. Gisiko wa-sae nilgagringgiminko ua katta me-suao donskaa. Agangrikatanirangoni mitamrang bakrooba, kattarang wa-saani gimin poraimitingo poraigipani gisikko cha-brangatjawa. Jakkalronggija kattarangkoba ia seanio jakkale uarangko tangchapilata. Pa Sangma songsarni golporangko bang-en seaha. Indiba Dakmesokaniko seanide ian jak on-chenggipa ine ua agana. "Dimbri Matgrik” baksana ua minggipin Dakmesokanikoba “Jugl SUchl” ine katta bichong on-e sea. Dakmesokaniko seani bewal da- ode una mikgimalangaignok; uni gimin bang-bata Dakmesokanirangko uni jakoniko ka-dongchaksoaniara ong-gramaijawa ine anga bebera-a. Schoolo, Collegeo aro Universityo aide ra’na man-nagipa aro skina kragipa seanirang^o bang’On nangeng^a. la Dakmesokani iani bidingo on’gilpana aro gipinran^o didiatna man*gen. Uni segimin "Dimbri Blatgrlk” Dakmesokaniko poraie nicheng giparangoni saksa ong*na aro ia

Do ga nitimgipa Bijnini Sipai dal gipa Dejangpani demechik Dimbrini Ma-gipa Mrik Rajani jikburing Raniko nirokgipa [Vi] MINGSA MINGGNI KATTA C hong- mo tde, A-chik ku-sikchi A-chik Jatni Ma-ambiko sea-jotachi maming ripingani dongbajani gimin, A-chikrangni Ma-ambini bidingo name tale ma-sina bilongen neng beani ong-a. Saobarang Dimbriko Songdu nalsachi nokkol dake donbaachim ine agana aro mitamrang nokkol dake ong-ja, indiba rajani jikgipa dakesa donbaachim ine agananiba donga. Mitamrang me chik sakprakna te rik pangprak dake sak ritchagittam me-chikrangko donbaa ine agana. Dimbriko je obostaoba donbachina, indiba A chikrang Songduko chobatbana skang ua Songdu nalsani rajarangna maiba ka-onangani ba uamangna maiba namgijagipa gisik saani kamko ka baachimkon ine chanchiman a. Uni giminsa A-chikrangni Songduko chobatbae neng take

misal cha-mitingoba Dhobani raja aro Koch Biharni raja bolgni nangrime A-chikrangko bobil dingbaachim, Songdu nalsaona rikbaachim. Bobilrangko niksoe A-chik Matgrikrang rang-san mi cha-ako dongale, mil-am sepi ra-bildange - me-a- me-chik nangrime bobilko warachaksona krimkro ku-cholsan ong-soachim ine A-chikrangni Ma-ambio aganani donga. Dongdipgija salgittam walgittam [vii] chri bra watosa, mil am sepi ra bildange chingsoosa, Raja Bihari aro Dhobani raja, A chik Matgrikrangni ka dongbeako nike, amchakjana kenchake katangpilaiaha. Misal cha-mitingo bobilrang baksa dakgrikna nangani giminan ia dakgrikram biapkon “MISAL CHA-RAM’ ine mingaha. Uni ja-man, A chikrang ua biaponi bang gija chel'kalaona jitange “A-song Neng-abat Chiga Neng'Chibat** minggipa biapo dongeaha. Raja Bihari aro Bijnini raja bolgni nangrime, adita sipairangko rimbitbae ia biaponaba A chikrangko bobil dingna rikbataiaha. A chikrang jama janggi galpile bobilko warachaksoaha aro ia dakgrikanio me asarang baksa me chikrangba rimol sa am pangpike, sok kanako dongale, mil am sepi

chakpile bilongen dakgrikpaaha. Ia dakgrikanio bilongen an chi-pari ong aha aro bang en siaha. la dakgrikanio A chikrangan bobilrangko amchepataha aro ia biapkon “GARO MARI TOPLA KHAWA” - ine da oba mingkuenga. Songdu nalsani raja A chikrangko Songdu chibimako chobatbachina inean te rik pang ritchagittamko kusi ong ean on atode ba on-atachim ong-ode, Songduko chobatbaani ja man A chikrangko ia nalsaonade bobil dake dingbana, rikba-chabana nangjajokchim. Indiba A chikrangni Ma ambi Agananio Songduko chobatbaani ja manba ua nalsani rajarang A-chikrangko bobil dingbaachim. Kusi ong ean Songduko chobatangchina ba chobatbachina ine A chik Pagitchamrangna te rik pang ritchagittamko [viii] on nata ong ode, Songduko chobatbaani ja man maina A chikrangko bobil dingbaachim? Maina? Maina bobil dingbaachim saoba aganna man genma? A chikrangni ka dongana, bilak wa saana, bamjana aro ka grakana mikkangchi kenchakesa, A-chikrangni bilgriengamitingo, A chikrangko mangkimaatna aro uamangni mikkangoniko chel atna miksongesa, Songduko

chobatbaani ja-manba bobil dingbaachimma? Ong jaode maina? la ‘Maina’ ine gisiko sing'a nakatani giminan ia Dakmesokanio ba Dramao Dimbriko dingtang dake mesokna jotton ka'aha. Ua saksa Matgrik chong'motchim. Rori Sadepa Nokma Chigatpani A'chikrangko onchep mikchepako aro chonnikako chaktojaenba Dimbri Matgrik uko budi dake so'otachim. Dimbri Matgrikni Rori Sadepa Nokma Chigatpako so'otani koborko man ne ua nalsani rajarang jajrengtokaha. Uni ja'man uamang baditaba bol rajarang tom dakc A chikrangko bobil dingbana ku'mongaha. Songduko chobatbaani ja-manba A-chikrangko bobil dingbaani a-selko ning-tue chanchiate niode, indaken ong-achimkon ine darangan chanchiman-aigcn. Rori Sadepa Nokma Chigatpa siahani giminan, songdu nalsaona A chikrangko bobil dingbataigiparangni gisepode uni bimingko knataina ba mingtaian dongjaha. Uni orto, uko A chik Matgrik Dimbrian so-otchong-motachim. Uni giminsa songdu nalsani rajarang Dimbri Matgrikni Jatko jakbikpilna aro mangkimaatna ine songdu nalsaonaba bobil [ix]

dingbaachim, a jak sokbaachim. Maina, a sel gride Songduko batsotbagimin A chikrangko bobil dingbaani maming a selko nikatna man ja. lani bidingo maming a selko ma ambi aganriting- baanioba agana dongja. Chong motan, Dolgoma gita Songduko terik pang ritchagittamko chap kae batsotbagipa A chikrangnade Dimbri Matgrik ‘Jokatgipa’ chacha ong aha. A chik Jat gimiknan Dimbri Matgrik rasong chaani ong-chongmota. Dimbriko ia Dakmesokanio ba Dramao saksa ka dongbegipa, Jatna kas aagipa aro Jatna ;in tangko on kanggipa Matgrik ong a ine mesokaha. Hai, Dramako poraiangna icicicic M Dakmesoka I MESOKANII Raja Montri Raja Bijni, Rajani nokdring (Raja Bijit Narayan, ja' man ja' man jako lekka ra'e Montri napbaa) : Ah: mai dikdar! Na'songara angko dikdiksaba tom tom neng takna

on jawama? Na an on tisa chanchie niboching. : Raja, ia a'gilsakko nikama nikjaenga; ia a'gilsak rokomari bosturangko chile chakchike jrip dongaienga. Na'ara maina indita dongsiksakenga, chakchikbo. ; Ha! Ha! Montri, a'gilsak baksa angko maichi tosusana man'a? A'gilsakkode indake chakchiknan Isol tariaha - indiba angade saksa chonbegipa mandesan ong'aia, cha'na-ringna, tusina-bamsina, somoi gita neng'tak- na - ia pilakrangko man jaode angna name janggi tangna neng'beani ong'gen. Niboda, anga da'o on'tisa [ 1 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dhaniram Montri Raja Dhaniram : Dakmesoka I [Mesokani I] aratengaha. la pilak lekkarangko attamchipak nina man'aigen;

maming koti ong jawakonba? Manas rikamo dongenggipa Garorang aro gipin bobilrangde da'o bobil dingna re' baj aengakonba . (Dhaniram napbaa) Are, Dhat-'ram? Re'ba, re'ba, na'a namengakonba? Oe, namenga raja, nang'ni ia nokkol namean dongenga. Nang'gila ka'sa- ninggipa rajani ning'o donggipa saobana maiba namgijani ong'na amama? (An'tangna agana) Pilakan chu'sok- aignok da'ode - maiko nanga? Ia jaraan pilakko nosto ka'aignok, bijak tognigipakoba mesengataignok! Ia ku'dcng dongpaode maming knman ong'jawaha. Che! Angadc re aignok. Jararangko ja'rikode angni maming lap ong'jawa, indinari ncng'gram- aiasan ong'aigen. (Parake) Raja, angni noko on'tisa nangchong- motgipa ka'gni kam dongachim, na'a ge'etode anga da'o re'naha. De indide .

(Salam ka'e Montri ong'katanga) (Dhaniramko miksonge) Mai song- badko ra'bajok, Dhaniram? (Ka'dingsmite) Raja, ia buringni pilak [2] Dimbri Matgrik Raja Dhaniram Raja Dhaniram : Raja : Dhaniram : Raja : Oakmesoka I [Mesokani I] pulnikon na'a changprakde bitchi opmanaha; opkugijani gisepo gihmat, makkaligi aro datura pulrang, jean bisi gnanggipa, uarangsan bangki dongengkua. Bao? Manas rikamo songdongenggipa ua Garorangni gisepoba nang'na krana gita me'chikkon nikatna man jaenga. Maiko agana? Sagalara basakoba chi gri ong'na amama? Maiko agangen raja! Indake pangnan

ope dongode pulrangni bitchi maina, sagalni chiba tipe kataigen. Indide da'o maiko dakbo, mai chol donga aganboching? Donga, uni gimin na'a mamingna chanchina nangja. la a'gilsako damsasan ong ja, damsni sagalrang donga. Dhaniram, nang'ni kattarangko knae angni gisik bilongcn dongsik- sakbeengaha. Indide da'o maiko dakna nanggen aganboching? Mai chol donga? Choi donga, ua cholni gimin anga nang'na ja'mano agangen. Na'a ia noksako name dake nie niboching. lako nang'na mesokgen inean anga ia noksako ra'baaha. (Noksako nitate) Bah! lara sani noksa mancha aganboching? Indake [ 3 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dhaniram Raja Dhaniram

Raja Dhaniram : Raja Dhaniram : Raja Dakmesoka I [Mesokani I] silaniko anga maming saloba nika dongkuja. : Raja, na'asan ong ja. Indake silako haida ia a'gilsako da'ona kingking darangba nikkuja, nika dongkuja. : Ong'bebeankon! Is! Mairongpile sila! Oi Dhaniram, ia mongnalara badia chibolo bale dongenga, na'a angna aganna man'genma? Aganode anga da'oan balminduri gita uni sambaona re'angaigen. : Raja, iani bidingo indita adik sikdik dakode cholijawa. Ia kamko ramram ine chanchinabe. la teng'sugipa jajong salgiosa dongenga. Uni wilwilao pangnan matgrikrangsa nitime dongrongenga. Su'sam aro tampi mangsaba uni sambachi re'angna man jaenga.

Mama? A'selara maimancha? Agangen raja, agangen Agangalgalboda! Maina kena? Raja, iara Manas chibimani rikamo scrigdongenggipa Nokmani jikgipa Me gam Nongalni demechik ong' a - uni bimingko Dimbri minga - bilongen sila. (Rasong chaa gnang) Chong'mot! (Noksako nie ) Dhaniram, na'a aganachim ia teng'sugipa jajong salgisakosa dongenga; chong'motan [ 4 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dhaniram : Raja Dhaniram : Raja Dhaniram : Raja : Dhaniram : Raja OaKmesoka I [MesoKanil] uagitan ong'bebeakon! Ah! Je ma'kringo hajal hajal singho gita

ka'grak matgrikrang atchiaha, je ma'kringni rasong mikkim ia a'songo gapa, ua ma'kringo ba jato indake silgipa mongnal bibal chajaode bano chagen? Je Isol ia nitogipa Manas chibima rikamo silsila buring bolgrimrangko chaataha nitoataha, uan iakoba silata aro ia nitogipa nomilkoba tariaha, dakaha. Is , nibo, Dhaniram — Ge'etbo, raja. Na'a ia Manas rikamo songdongeng- gipa Nokmani bimingko mai minga u'iakonba? U'ija. (U'ioba u'ija ine agana) Ua Nokmako manderang Dejangpa ine okamronga; uni biming gitan uni kamba ong'a. Ia noksako nike Dejangpani demechik ong'nan krae nika. Uara maidake, raja? Na'ara jarama! Dipari Me'chik Namari Tirani oko Sikme aro Donse atchiama atchija? (An'tangna agana) Na'tok da'osa

milsiko minokbaengaha. Da'o iako maiba dake a'gaona de'gatna man jokon ong'aignok. Nibo, Dhaniram! [ 5 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dhaniram Raja Dhaniram Raja Dhaniram Raja ; Dhaniram : Raja : Dhaniram : Dakmesoka I (Mesokani I] Ge'etbo, raja! Na'a ia noksako angna on'bo — Raja, anga nang'ni nokkolsan ong'a; ango je donga ua pilakan nang'nin ong'a. Indiba indiba Mai indiba, aganbo? Cliong'motde, ia noksa ia nokkolni ong'ja; ong'ode da'oan rajana on'aignokchim. Dumuryani angni

ripeng saksa ia songjinmaona re'baachim. Uasa ia noksako palchi- na gita ango donangaha. Indide namaha. Nang'ni ripengna iani kraa damko on'atjokon ong'ai- genkonba? (An'tangna agana) Da'ode bachi rc'anggen? Da'ode ja'gao ga'akaha. (Parake) Ong'aigen, ong'nan nang- gcn. Ua ia noksako palnasa ianona ra'bara; uni gimin kraa damko man'odc maina paljawa? Indiba, ua je damko aganenga, ua on'tisa bang'kale agana gita daknik- man'enga, raja. Dhaniram, ia noksa angni ka'tongna gamchatgipa gamjin gita ong'a. Nama, aganboching, nang'ni ripeng badita am'enga? (An'tangna agana) Gamchatgipa gamjin gita ong'a? Indide maina kena? (Parake) Raja, ua hajal [ 6 ] Dimbri Matgrik Raja

Dhaniram Raja Dhaniram : Raja Dhaniram : Dakmesoka I [Mesokani i] kolgrikbonga bi'enga. lana komie ua maming dakeba on'jawa ine agananga. Bang'batan una hajal kolgrikde on'na am'ahachimna, indiba da'oba ua : Ong'aigen; indide ua jegita bi a uagitan on'na nangaigen. Anga jakrikrana chitti seataina, na a uni jakoniko tangkako ra'bae nang'ni ripengna on'atbo. Bao? lanode seatna gita jako maming lekkaan dongja. Raja, ge'etode anga da'oan lekkako ra'baaigen. De indide ra'ebo. Indide anga ra'enaha, raja. (Ong'katanga) (An'tangna agana) Dejangpani jikgipa Me'gam Nongalni indake

silbea demechik donga ine angade jumangomangba chanchijachim. O nitogipa mongnal, na'a badia risini sao-sarapko man'e ia chibolo dongna nangengaha? (Sena jako lekka ra'e Dhaniram napbataia) Raja, iakai ra'baaha. (Raja lekkako ra'chake asonge sena a'bachenga an'tangna agana) Muni nangatani ja'manan bitede nangeng- aha. Da'o nina, iarang bano maidake [ 7 ] Dimbri Matgrik Raja Dhaniram Raja Dhaniram Raja Dhaniram ; Dakmesoka I [Mesokani IJ bon'chota. Jotton ka'anio maming gualani dongjawa. Uni ja'man mamingko nangja, cha'ukokrangna- de cha'na man'aan lap! Cha'na

man jokode maiko nanga? Maming korosan ka'a dongja, indiba lapsan lap! : la ra'angbo. (Chittiko on'ata) : Raja, na'a jaksrambegipa ong'a. : Na'a angna indigita gamchatgipa gamjinko on'aha; uni gimin anga nang'na jringjrotna gro nanga. : Raja, anga nang'ni nokkol mang- mangsan ong'a! Indiba raja, na'a ia nokkolni kattako knachakode, unode na'a nengraen ia me'chik gamjinko man'na amaigen. (Chakate) Bebema, Dhaniram? Angara indita rasong gnanggipa ong'ama? Raja, na'a Manas chibimani rikamo songdongenggipa Nokmani demechikna ka'saengode ua ka'saani chu'sokchongmotgen; nang'ni ska chu'sokchina anga Gitelo bi'enga. Nang'ni pagitchamrangba uamang baksa nangrimean janggi tangang- aha; na'aba kraa gitan chananga sila aro rasong gnanggipa ong'a. Nang'ni

rani ong'na Dimbri nomil kra- chong'motgen. Nang'ni bimingko knajokode haida Dejangpa demechik- [ 8 ] Dimbri Matgrik Raja Dhaniram Raja Dhaniram : Raja Montri __ Dakmesoka I [Mesokani I] tangko nang'na pakwatna maming saloba jechakjawa. ; Oe — uamang baksa angni pagitchamrang nangrime meliean dongangachim; indiba angade saksa dingtanggipa gisikni ong'a; ua iani bidingo ku'rachakjaode, jechakode, angni kratcha'ani ong'gen. : Raja, na'a Saljagring ma'chongni bon'kamgipa ong'a. Dal'gipa man- derangde an'tangtangni giminde gualtokaia. Uni gimin na'ade an'tangni rasong mikkimkon ma'sija.

Citing raniara Dikkiko chonnik- soachimma? : (Chanchia gita dake) Atcha - na a changsa montriko okamatboching. De indide, raja. (Ong'katanga) (An'tangna agana) Nina, montriara maiko ina. Iani bidingo ta'rak ta'rak adik sikdik daka kraani ong'jawa. Nokma Dejangpa ku'rachakode, jechakjaode, anga bilongen kusi ong'begen, an'tangko rasong gnang- gipa ine chanchigen. (Asonga) (Montri baksa Dhaniram napbataia) Raja na'a ku'watode, ia adita chittirangko nang' mikkango poraina nangengachim. [ 9 ] Dimbri Matgrik Raja Montri Raja Montri Raja Montri

Dhaniram ; Montri Dhaniram : Dakmesoka I [Mesokani I] : Don, don! Uarangko ja'mano nina man'gen. Da'o asongchengbo. Nang baksa angni dingtangmancha katta aganani donga. : (Asonge) Maiko dakna nanga ge'etbo. : Nibo, Montri, Nokma Dejangpani badita sak bi'sa-di'sarang donga, angna aganna man'genma? : Oe, baditaba sakrang donga. : Badita sak depante aro badita sak demechikrang? : Aganna man'jawa, indiba uni demechikgipa Dimbrini giminsan anga knana man'aha. Uamang Gaur A songoni katbae Dhubrio songdong- mitingosa Dimbri atchiaha. Dhubrio atchiani giminsa uni bimingko Dimbri mingaha. Dhubrini Dhobani raja uamangko uno bang'a bilsina dongna on jani giminsa uamang da'o ia Manas rikamo re'bae dongenga.

Raja, Nokman' demechik Dimbri silbebeama? Mitam manderang agana Citing Rani an'tangan a'gilsako atchitaiaha ine. Indide montri, na'a an'chingni rajana ia silbegipa Nokman' demechikko man'e on'na maina jotton ka'jaenga? An'chingni rajaba chong'mot Dikkian atchitaia gitan ong'a! [ 10 ] Dimbri Matgrik Montri Raja Montri Raja Montri Raja „ Dakmesoka I [Masokani I] : Maina jotton ka'jawa? Indiba iano on'tisa champenga donga gita daka. : Ua champenganiara mai? : Oe raja, Kamagiri a'songni Nokma Sae-Bonge aro Kateni su'gipa baksasa uni bia ka'ani katta ong'ahachim, indiba ua siahani gimin

kam chu'sokna man jaha. Anga da'o knana man'enga, ua a'songni saksa matgrik uko bia ka'na ine uni skaniko Nokmana parakaha. Ua matgrikni bimingko Baucheng minga. : Chong'motma? Tom'betbet dakari ua jajongko rim'na jotton ka'engama? la Bauchengara Ginje Me'chikni depatchi bi'sasa ong'a, uko a'gimikni manderangan u'itoka. Ua Nokman' demechik Dimbriko kimna am'enga? Aiao inmana! Amakba me'chikna mikbokna changama? Nibo, montri na'a da'oan Nokman* a'songona mande watatbo. Angna Nokman' demechik Dimbriko nanga. (Chakate) Baucheng iano seng'a dakode, indide uko anga kraagita sasti on'gija tom'tomna man jawa! : O toromi raja, da'o iarangna chanchie sko sae dongani somoi ong ja. Nibo, bobilrang a'songni wilwilao sal salna bilakbaroroengeiha. : Ah: bobilrang! Na'a bobilrangni gimin

chanchie adha pagla gita [II] Dimbri Matgrik Dhaniram Raja Montri Raja Dhaniram : Raja Dakmesoka I [Mesokani I] ong'pilengaha. Saksa Pragjyotish- pumi raja, uade da' ode bisi grigipa chipu gitasan ong'aiaha. Gipin- rangnade kenja. Uamangde tangka sonarangko man'jokode kusi ong'ai- gen. Na'a re'angbo. Na'a da'o ta'rake mande watatna jotton ka'bo. Bauchengni mai ka'donga ua ang- ming kajia ka'nasa jikenga. (Gipinchiko nie) Raja, ia nokkolko wataton ong'aigenchim! (Gipinchiko nie) lade namgenan. Na'a saksa bilongen chalakki mande; na'a re'angon nambatgen. (Parake) Nibo, Montri, na'a Dhaniramkon

Manas rikamona watatbo, bian nambebegen. Nang'ni ge'eta gitan ong'china. (Dhaniramchipakko nie) Mamasong, indide na'a ang' baksa re'bapabo. lani bidingo mai maiko dakna nanga uarangko tik ka'na. Re'angbo, Dhaniram, re'angbo. Nang'ni ge'eta gitan ong'china. (Montri aro Dhaniram ong'katanga) (lachi uachi re'jingjange) Ah, indaka silbegipa gamjinko man'aniara angni rasong kopalo dongama? Nina, Gitel maiko daka. Dhaniram bilongen chalakkigipa mande ong'a; ia kamko ua chu'sokatna man'jaode sawa man'gen. (Dhaniram napbataia) [ 12 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dhaniram Raja Dhaniram Raja Dhaniram

Raja Dhaniram : Raja Dhaniram ; Raja ... Dakmesoka I [Mesokani I] : Raja : Mai ong'a, na'a da'o maina re'bapilaha? : Oe raja, montri baksa angni mingsa kattani bidingo jegrikna nangao ga'akaha. Uni giminan da'oba nang'ona re'bataina nangaha. : Uara mai katta? Oe, ia nokkoini chanchia gitade adita sipairangko rimangpaode namgen- chim; indiba montriara ang baksa sipairangko watatpaode koros bang'gen ine aganenga. Ha....! Ha....! Ha....! Budepa ong jokode indakarangko chanchiani gisiko nakatbaaia! Indide montriara nang'ko saksan watatna skengama? Oe, indaken ong'enga. Che, kratcha'ani katta! Indinarian

anga da'ororo gisiko sukjaenga, ka'onangna nangode pilakan bikpil bawil ong'anggen. Ong'chongmot raja, iani gimin chanchinan nangja. la nokkolba indaken aganachim. Atcha - na'a montrina indake aganebo, ua nang baksa mang ritchasa gure, mangbonga mongma aro sak hajalsa sipairangko watat- pachina. Indaka kamrango tangka paisani gimin chanchiaiode cholijawa. [ 13 ] Dimbri Matgrik . . . _ _ Dakmesoka I [Mesokani I] Dhaniram : Raja, na'a teng'achi Salgra, bilakachi Goera, ka'onangachi Susime, jaksramachi Rokkime, ka'saachi Sagal, rinokachi mongnal aro u'ianichi Tatara Rabuga chong'mot. Chanchie nibo, jensalo Gitel Tatara Rabuga, a'gilsakko dakna ge'etaha, unon Nostu Nopantu, Machi, Chipong Nokma Balpong Gitel aro Chiching Barchingmaangni dak-

chakachisa ong'atna amachim. Saksande maming saloba dakjachim. Raja : Nibo, Dhaniram, Dhaniram : Ge'etbo raja — maiko dakna nanga. Raja : Jegita Tatara Rabuga Chongchong Mindako Salgisakoni A'gilsakona aro A'gilsakoni Salgisakona kobor ra'rurana jakkalachim, uandake angaba nang'ko watatenga. Nibo, Dhaniram, simsake ka'angbo angni skani indinari ong jachina. Dhaniram ; Raja, nang'ni ska-namnikaniko chu'sokatna angni janggi sipilna nangoba anga watgaljawa; indiba rajao angni mingsa mol'molani dongachim. Raja : Uara mai? Dhaniram : Raja, Tatara Rabuga jensalo Chongchong Mindako watatachim, uno una ge'sa sonani gol'dikko on'atpaachim; ia nokkolniara maia donga raja? [ 14 ] Dimbri Matgrik Raja

Dhaniram Raja Dhaniram : Dakmesoka I [Mesokani I] : (Ka'dinge) lakai ra'bo. Na'a ia jakstemko ra'bo. : Raja, na'a Rokkimeni depante chong'mot ong'a. : Indide da'o maina ruutkuenga? Na'a montriona re'ange da'alan re'chakat- angna tariebo. Re'angbo, ruutna- beha. Anga da'o bariona roramang- kuna. (Ong'katanga) (An'tangna agana) Da'ode na'a bachi re'angnaka re'angaibo. Angni kam chu'sokaha. (Re'jingjange) Dhaniram indinari ramramgipa mande ong'ja. Manas rikamni badinggipani jakoniko noksako maming paisa grian indinari ra'rikaiaha; aro ua noksakon rajana pale bang'e tangka man'aha! lara ramram budini kamma! Ha....! Ha....! Ha....! Hajal kolgrikbonga tangka! Ha....! Ha....!

Ha....! lani gisepon ia jakstemkoba man'aha! (Jakstemko nie) Bah! Badita silbea ia muni! Angni ambi- atchurangba indaka gamchatgipa muniko nikangja! Jeba ong'bo, mittela Dhaniram nang'ko! Nang'o aiao inmangipa budirang, dong- chongmota, bang'chongmota! Chinga rajani ge'etarangko manigiparang ong'a; rajachiko indaka bosturangko tol'e togieba man'na amjaode [ 15 ] Oimbri Matgrik Dakmesoka I [Mesokani IJ sachiko man'gen? Indaken ra'na nanga. Are, ia chasongode agre namdugae mesokode mamingnan cholijawa! Basakoba somoini kri namgijakoba nambea inna nangao ga'akaia; basakoba indinari saoba- rangko dosi ong'a gita aganna nangaia; tol eba aganna nanga aro basakoba kajia ong'atna man'a nanga -ian songsarni niam. lani orto, jegitaba an'tangni miksongako

chu'sokatna jotton ka'angna nanga! Indake dakgija, jean an'tangni gisikni kattako aganaia, ua mandeko mande mingna kraama? Uni gisikde nagande donggipa gitan apsan! Maming pindapanian dongja. Jeba jekoba dakangna man'aia - indake kakketgipa manderang a'gilsako name janggi tangangna man ja. Siani ja'man — mai siani ja'man? Siani ja'man maming a'gilsakan dongja - Salgi-Norokba tol'asa. Simanahaode mande mamingko ma'sijana, okkrijana, sin'jana, grapa-chrikaba dongjana — indide ua Salgini sukko aro Norokni dukko maiko ma'sigen? Ha....! Ha....! Ha....! Re'gnok, re'ange tangkarangko jakkipchengna nang- gen; uni ja'man montrichiba re'angna nanggen. Ah! Montrian angni ramani bu'su gita ong'a! Namen namaha, nina, montriniara badita mancha budi donga! (Ong'katanga) ***

[ 16 ] MESOKANin Bijni, Taposini Nok (Taposi napbaa) Taposi : (An'tangna agana) Aiao inmanani ong a, rajara da'al indake rnaina ruutengaha, indake ruutbaani a'selara mai ong'na nanga? (Rang'spee) Nama - anga ia denggugipa Dhiman Barmanna maidake gisiktangko on'kang- manaha? Angni ia chadambe gisikni ching'doa-chadoanichi jeko jak- pattalo jakkipe nokkol dake rakkigen ine chanchiachim, bikpil angasa be'entangni chiktet-cha'tetana, gisikni dongdikana uni nokkol ong'pila gita ong'aha! Angara do'o gita adal am'rame majalosa ga'akahama ? Indake ong'jaode, angni gisik maina rajako nikjani gimin indita dongsiksakbena nanga? (Rang'spee) Rajani re'baani [ 17 ] Dimbri Matgrik

Nandina Taposi Nandina Taposi Nandina Taposi Nandina Dakmesoka I [Mesokani II] somoiba ong'aha; angko da'al mai rokom dakeba nikenga sawa ma'sia? (Janerani mikkango chadenge) (Nandina napbaa) (Parake) Nandina re'baama? Niboch- ing, angni mikkang bimangko da'al janerao maidake nikenga? : Bilongen .ilbee nika, mongnal balsa rongtalgipa chibolo balgaoe dong- enga gita daknikman'pila! Jeba ong'bo, uarangko gualbo! Da'o anga je kattako agangen ine re'baa, ua kattako nachil songe knachengbo. : Mai, mai uara? Raja re'baengahama? : Mai Raja? Rajara nang'ni ong'e dongkuengama ua nang'ona re'ba- nara?

: Maina? Maina? Uara mai katta? Mai ong'aha aganboching - : Maiko knagen? Ua Dhaniramko nikjokkonba, uni giminde na'a namedake ma'sia dongkuja. Ugita dake choletgipa cha'chipilgipa denggu mande saoba dongkuama? : Maina? Uara maiko dakjok? : Maiko ua dakjawa? Nang'ni uko dakchaka dipet ua nang'ni katta gitan choliachim; indiba da' ode ua dingtang ramako re'na chanchieng- aha. [ 18 ] Dimbri Matgrik Taposi Nandina Taposi Nandina Taposi Nandina _ Dakmesoka I [Mesokani II] : Maiko inenga? Angade nang'ni maming kattarangkon ma'sina man jaengaha.

: Na'a maiko ma'sigen? Na'a Manas chibimani rikamo songdongeng- gipa Nokma Dejangpani bimingko knajok? : Maina knajawa? Ua saksa bilongen ka'donggipa, anTangni dakbewalko rim'kingkinge dongaigipa ong'a; uni bimingko sawa ma'sija? : Nang'ni namnikbatgipa ripeng Dhaniram ua Nokrnan demechik Dimbri baksa rajako bia ka'e on'na jotton ka'engaha, u'ijok? : la kattako nang'na sawa aganjok? ; Maina? la songjinmao nang'na agre haida ia kattani gimin pilakan u'itoka, ma'sitoka! Dhaniram an'tangan iani bidingo knalan Nokma Dejangpaona re'angna tik ka'aha. Ua da'oba Dhaniram ong'e dongkuengama? Ha! Na'ara maina grapenga? Che! Che! la kattako knae mangmang grapna nangama? Rajade nang'ni segipa ong'jaba, na'aba uni jikburingsan ong'a - na'a maina hangjang nang'ni segipa

chong'mot ong'gijagipana grapna nangjok? [ 19 ] Dimbri Matgrik Taposi Nandina Taposi Dhaniram Dakmesoka I [Mesokani 11] : Re'angbo, na'a da'o re'angbo- (Grapa) : Che! lara mai? Na'a mikron mikchikon rakkina man'jaengaha! Da'o mai dakgnok. Indake grapgen ine ma'siode anga nang'na ia kattarangko aganjawachim; — uara Dhaniram iachipakan re'baenga. Nibo ripeng, na'a ia a'seloni naljokna skode uni ramakosa am'angbo. Mikron mikchichide maming kam chu'sokna amja. Nang'ni mikron mikchiko nike nang'ko raja gisik ra'genma ma Dhaniram kengen? : Hai ripeng, an'ching ianoni on'tisa

jite chadengna. Haiwa Dhaniram re'baengaha. Nina, ua ianona re'bae maiko daka? (Mittinao dongnua) (Dhaniram napbaa) (An'tangna agana) Ha....! Ha....! Ha....! Montri ang baksa sipairangko watatpana skaan dongsrangjachim; indiba indaka budiko dake bon'kama- ode angni namnika gitan dakna nangaiaha. Ha....! Ha....! Ha....! Rajaba ong'bo montriba ong bo, Dhaniramni ja'gao ga'akna pilakan nangtelaigen! Dhaniram kamtangko maming saloba gualja! Da'o sipairangna chamgipa tangkako jako man'chengna nanggen; uni [ 20 ] Oitnbri Matgrik Dakmesoka I [Mesokani II] ja'man, ramarango jeko man'a uarangkoba watjawa. Indita sipai- rangko ang baksa watatpaenga, angna mai kenani? (Chanchia gita dake) Taposina ka'sa-ka'paka rajani ka'tongoni sal salna chel'ang- rikrikengaha. Da'oara maina? Uade

da ode angko mamingchiba dak- chakna bil man'jawaha, dongjaha. Indiba ia me chikba bilongen silade sila. Jeba ong'bo, changsa ukoba grongangsrangna. (Parake) Bao? Taposi bachi, bano? Bao darangba maina aganchakjaenga? (Taposi napbataia) Taposi : Mai, Dhaniram? Maiko chanchie re' baa, aganboching knana? Dhaniram : Maiko chanchigen? Nang'ni sila- nitoani giminan gisiko chanchienga- chim. Taposi : Angni sila nitoani gimin? Indake toTna sawa nang'na skiaha agan- boching? Dhaniram : Sawa skigen, angni mikron rong- gnian angna skiaha. Taposi : De! De! Oi Dhaniram, na'a da'oro- rode bilongen bal'ekna changgipa me'asa ong'baengaha, mo? Dhaniram : Ong'jaode mai ong'gen? Nikjama, Tatara Rabugani ge'etako man e Nostu-Nopantu a'gilsako, aski- [ 21 ]

Dimbri Matgrik Dakmesoka I [Mesokani II] tanoriko dakaha - - angaba nang'ni nokkolsan ong'a - ge'etaibo maiko dakna nanga. Taposi : Nama Dhaniram, namen nama, knaman'enga na'a saoba me'chikni kingsa noksako rajana hajal kolgrikbongana palahana, ong'ama ong ja? Dhaniram : S sawa nang'na ia kattako aganjok? Taposi : Jeba aganchina. Indiba ia kattara kakket ong'ama ong'ja? Dhaniram : Ong'ja tol'asa. Indaka kattako sawa nang'na aganjok? Na'aba saksa! Da'ororo hajal kolgrikbonga tang- kako sawa sana indinari on'aigen? Taposi : (Dhaniramni gangipa jakstemko nike) Are, iara mai? Na'a ia gamchat- gipa jakstemko banoniko man'jok? Dhaniram : (An'tangna agana) Ah! la me'chikara ong'ai ong'jai kattarangkosa sing e roengaha da'oara? (Parake) la jakstemko raja name tarie donchina

angna on'aha. Taposi : Bebema? Ong'bebeankon! Nama, Dhaniram, mikka wajokode chibol jegita chiko chimonge rakkia, uandake na'aba rajani maiba bosturangko man'ode simsake rakkironga, ong'ama ong'ja? Dhaniram : Ong'naba donga, sawa u'ia? Na'a mai maiko aganenga angade ma'sinan [ 22 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dakmesoka I [Mesokani II] man'j aengaha. Taposi : Maidake ma'sina man'gen? Nang'gita dake sontolbegipa mande saoba banoba dongama? Anga indakesa aganachim, je a' ran kario ran'kreke donggipa chibolba mikka chiko man'ahaode chiko chimonge rakki- ronga, na'aba rajani maiba bosturangko man'ode indaken rakkironga, ong'ama ong ja? Uarang jeba ong'china; mingsa kattakosa anga nang'o sing'na skengachim - chong'motan - na'ara Manas rikamo

songdongenggipa Nokman' demechik baksa rajako bia ka'e on'na jotton ka'engana, ia kattaara kakketma? Dhaniram : (An'tangna agana) A'i maidakesa! la matcha bimara ia pilak kattarangko maidake u'itokaha, knaaha? Taposi : Mai ong'aha, maina katta agangija jripjrip dongenga? Dhaniram : Atcha, nang'na indake tol a kattarangko sawa aganjok? Taposi : ToTa? Anga nang'ni chalakki daka budirangko indita sal nirikkie ma'sina man'aha; na'a ang baksa je bewalko mesokaha aro je kattarangko aganaha, ia pilak kattarangko raja knaode, nang'ko Manas rikamo songdongenggipa Nokmaona watat- gija, Chitmangonasa watatgenchim! la kattako na'a u'iama u'ija? [ 23 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dakmesoka I [Mesokani II] Dhaniram : Na'ade indake agangenan da'ode. Nang'ni maming dos dongja. Indakaan ia chasongni torom ong'a! Ian chasong gital ong'a. la chasongo

dakchakgipakon cha'sotani chasong ong'a. Na'a an'tangni giminan chanchie nichengbo, na'a maichim aro da'o mai ong'aha! Da'o na'a rani chacha gita suk ong'e janggi tangna man'enga; iara sani dakchakachi, gualahama? Da'o na'a angko cha'sotna jotton ka'jaode sawa ka'gen? Na'aba saksa ia chasong gitalni me'chikan ong'ajokna. Taposi : Oe - angaba ia chasong gitalni me'chik ong'a! Indiba na'aba chasong gitalni togirakgipa saksa Saitan ong'a. Na'a angko angni batanggimin salni kattarangko gisik ra'ataha, indiba na'a an'tangba on'tisa an'tangni gimin chanchie niboching. Na'an tangkana mikboke angni cholono kakketani toromko nosto ka'chenggipa ong'ama ong'ja. Anga kangalni demechik ong'oba kakket cholonon janggi tangen- gachim. Da'ode, Dhaniram, na'an aganboching, badia denggu mande ia dos grigipa do'oko rim e ra'bae ia

pattok gita dakgipa sonani gringo donenga? (Grapa) Dhaniram : (An'tangna agana) la me'chikna pilak kattarangko aganade kraani [24J Dimbri Matgrik Taposi Dhaniram : Taposi Dhaniram : Mittinoni : Dhaniram : Dakmesoka I [Mesokani 11] ong jawa, ua bang'bata kattarangkon ma'sitokaha; una agreba, raja ia kattarangko knana man'jokode obostaan namsrangjawa. (Parake) Knabo, Taposi, anga da'ona kingking nang'na maming namgijako daka dongkujaenga, jeko dakengoba anga nang'ni namgninan dakkuenga ; na'a angni kosako indinari maina ka'onangenga? Indide rajana bia ka'ani kattako sawa nakatchengata?

Uko anga maidake ma'sigen? Maidake ma'sigen? Na'an iani ‘dalali’ •ka'enga, na‘a ma'sijaode sawa ma'sigen? Ha! Ha I Ian na'song me'chikrangni ma'sisokgijagipa gisik ong'a, budi bakkandikani ong' a! Anga ‘dalali’ kamko ka'na nangengaha nang'ni namgnini giminan! Na'a bebera'jama anga ‘dalali’ ong'e re'angahaode ia bia maming saloba ong'jawa ine? Iani bidingo na'a tom'tom jajrenggija dongaibo! Iani ja'mansa na'a ma'sigen, Dhaniram nang'ni badita nambatgipa ripeng ong'a. Knajokma, Dhaniram ia noko dongama? Raja uko changsa grongna am'engana. Ua knabo! Anga da'o ianoni re'nakaha. Na'a iarangni gimin [ 25 ] Dimbri Matgrik Taposi Nandina Taposi

Nandina Taposi Oakmesoka I [Mesokani II] on'tisaba mamingnaba jajrengnabe. Raja ua me'chikko kimoba, angni tangenga dipet na'a mamingnaba jajrengna nangja. Nang'ni ia chadambeni bimang, rajani gamjin ong'a. (An'tangna agana) Nang'ni sila bimangko ra'ean dongbo, anga nang'ni skoon narikelko dokpretna rc'angengaha! (Ong'katanga) (Rang'spee an'tangna agana) Da'o rasong kopalo maiaan sea donga mamingkon ma'sina man'ja. Bao? Raja da'asalde angona re'bachipjaha. (Nandina napbataia) Mai rokom ripeng? Anga jeko agana ua kakketkonba? Indiba da'o iani gimin maiba chol dongama? la bia ong'ode, na'ade jringjrotna saksan sikdikdik janggi tangna nangaignok. Mai chol donga aganbo. Choi donga. Mamingna jajrengnabe.

Dhaniram chanchienga una bate chalakkigipa darangba dongja, indiba da'osa ua ma'sina man'gen uni badita mancha budi donga. Hai re' bo, ang baksa re'bapabo. Bigita dakgipa dengguko togina maming neng'nikani ong'jawa. Hai indide. ong'aride dongkamaija. Mandeni janggi tanganioba indaken ong'a. Na'a mamingnaba jajrengnabe. Nang'ni jat bilongen ka'donggipa jat ong'a. Indiba ua ka'donganiko budichisa jakkalna nanga. Nina, uamang mai mai kattarangni gimin agangrika. (Dongnue donga) (Jachingpa aro Dhaniram napbaa) Montri sahep, chadambemitingni somoio be'en chiktet cha'tet dakmitingo mande maiko dakja? Uandake chingni rajaba basakoba basakoba bikpil kamrangkosa dakronga; iarang maming aiao inmanani katta ong ja. Rajeini bilsiba bang'kuja. Na'an chanchie nibo, rajarangni nokdringo ong'rong- gijarangan badita ong'enga. Oe, ong'ade ong'aan! Indiba anga knaman'enga, Dhobani raja Taposi minggipa saksa me'chik baksa — - Oe, oe, maiko agangen sahep? Bija me'piliprangara pul balsaosan dongna ba unikosan bitchi opna

nanga ine maming niam dongja. Bija [ 45 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dakmesoka II [Mesokani II] me'pilip je pulonaba re'angna man'aia. Jachingpa : Indiba sahep, anga knaman'a, ia Taposi minggipa ramramgipa pul ongja. Dhaniram : (An'tangna agana) la katta toKade ong'ja. Angaba iani giminan jajrengenga. (Parake) Ong'aan, nang'na ia kattako sawa aganaha sahep? Ua saksa ramramgipa me'chiksan ong'a, da'al donga, knal dongja. Jachingpa : Sahep, Nokman' demechik Dimbri, ma'kringoni gisepo Dejangpani janggi silchi gitachacha ong'a. Uni gimin, iarangko knajokode maming saloba cholon grigipa raja ba mande baksa demechiktangko bia ka'na on jawakon. Dhaniram : Indakede ong ja sahep, ia katta- rangkode Nokmana knaatna nangja. Jachingpa : Knaatgen indake ong'ja, indiba

manderangni ku'ritingchi balpakang- gipa kattarangko sawa champengna man'gen? la kattarangko darangba donnuna man'jawa, wa'algita chadoaigen, an'tangtangan nakatang- aigen, pilak retrangan ma'sitokaigen; uko darangba champengna man - jawa. Dhaniram : Sahep, jajongo simteka donga ine saoba uko chonnika dongjokma? [ 46 ] Oimbri Matgrik Jachingpa : Dhaniram : Jachingpa : Dhaniram ; Jachingpa ; Dhaniram : Jachingpa : Dakmesoka II [Mesokani IIJ Indake ong'ja. Indiba ia jajongni simteka gita ong'ja; iade jajongko chu'gimik Nawang minoka gita ong'aha. Indakachi na'songni rajani mikkangchi bilongen namgijani aro

bodnam ong'ani, rasong mikkim gimaani ong'gen. (An'tangna agana) lade bilongen gondogol ong'ani kattasa ong'enga. Gondogolara mai? Angna namgnisa ong'aigen. Raja ia saru bimako gringoniko watatode bilongen nambegenchim. Angade una ja'ga sae donenga. Sahep, maina katta agangija jripjrip dongenga? Ong'ja — mane — anga indake chanchiman'enga je, ia chona kattaan nang'ni ka'tongo mitchiani- ko ong'atode, indide anga iani bidingo rajana chitti seatgen, raja ua denggu me'chikko bachiba gipin a'songona watatchinagita. Indake dakode haida maming apotia dongjawaha. Chong' mot, indake dakana agre mai chol dongkua? Raja Dhobani jodisa indaken daka, indide maming j’ajaani dongjawaha. Beben, maina dakjawa? Pitolni bodol

sawa sonako ra'jawa? Indide anga da'o re'nakaha. Na'aba re'ange neng'take dongebo. Nokma [ 47 ] Olmbri Matgrik Dhaniram Nandina Dhaniram ; Nandina Dhaniram : Nandina Dakmesoka ii [Mesokani II] baksa knal pringo grongna man'gen. (Ong'katanga) (An'tangna agana) Chingni rajani kamrang pilakchian gipangaha! Nama, indiba indinari janganggipa ku'ritingrangko jripatna maming chol dongjama? Maidake donggen? lani re'anide chibimani jokonanga gitan apsan. A'bachengode, a brioni chiring gita dake ong'katbae chibol aro wari ong'chenga; unoni jo'olange ka'sinsin ta'rakbaroroa; ja man ta'rake jokonange dal'gipa chibima

pil'a. Mandeni ku'riting knaritingani bidingba indaken ong'a. (Nandinako chel'ao nikate) Ahaha! la nitogipa panteara sawasai; uko u'isiksik dakmanenga. lakoara banoba nikahachimma? (Parake) Oi, angjong na'a iachipak re'baboching. (Mikkangchipakna re'ange) Na'a maikoba aganengachimma? Nang'ni bimingko mai minga, jong? Angni biming! Angni biming Nanjang. Bah : Knatoa biming. Nang'ma nang'pa indake knatoa bimingko nang'na donaha. Indiba na'a iano maiko dakenga? Anga iano donge poraienga skie ra'enga. [ 48 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dakmesoka II [Mesokani IQ Dhaniram : Eh! Muktaraxigko am'ean manderang tu'begipa sagalrango ripenga. Rajani nokdringba saged gitan ong'a. Na'a iano donge posan-poraiengama ma maikoba dakenga? Na'songni a'songo

poraianina maming chol dongjama? Atcha, ua kattarangko galbo, indiba angna mingsa kattaiko aganboching; Na'a Nokman' demechik Dimbriko nikmaij okma? Nandina : Oe, maina nikjawa? Jemang jajong baksa songdongenga uamang askirangko nikjawama? Dhaniram : Indide bilongen nama! Atcha jong, na'songni Nokman' demechikara nina mai rokom? Nandina ’ : Uni sila-nitoaniko anga kattachi parakna amjawa. Indiba ua Taposi mangmang gita ong'ja. Dhaniram : Ha sagita mangmangde ong'ja? Nandina : Na'ara nachil knajaengama, benga- ma? - Taposi! Taposi! Knajokma? Dhaniram : Ah — Taposiara sawa? Nandina : Ha....! Ha....! Taposi sawa, uko na'a u'ija mo? Ha — ! Ha — ! Ha — ! Dhaniram : (An'tangna agana) Aiao iade! Uni bimingko ia bi'saara maidake bachiko knajok? (Parake) Anga ukoara mai dake u'ina man'gen? Nandina : Ah: Angna maina kakketko

donnuenga? Na'a montrina je [ 49 ] Dimbri Matgrik _ Dakmesoka II [Mesokani II] kattarangko aganachim, ua pilak kattarangko anga knaaha. Dhaniram : (An'tangna agana) la kattarangni gimin mamingko agantaijaon nambatgen. (Parake) Oe angjong, anga nang ko mormolenga, na'a je kattarangko knaaha, knaaha, indiba ia kattarangni bidingo gipinrang baksa mai?dng saloba agangriknabe. Nandina ; Maina? Aganode mai ong'gen? Dhaniram : Mamingde ong'ja, nang'na anga nang'ni skagita mittai cha'na dangga on'gen, na'a indaka rajani nokdangni kamrangni gimin gisik nangna nangja; iarang nang'na maming namgni ong'jawa. Nandina : (Ka'onanga gnang) Na'a paglama! Na'a angko bi'sa nabalok ine chanchiengama, nang'ni mittaini paisana anga mikbokaigenmaT'^ Dhaniram : Indide aganbo, na'a maiko man'ode kusi ong'gen?

Nandina : Atcha, nang'ni jaksio ua jakstem donga, uko angna on'bo; unode anga darangnaba mamingkoba aganjawa. Dhaniram : Che jong, na'a angko pagla inachim; na'aba da'obatai paglaan ong'enga- ma? lako ra'e na'a maiko dakgen? lara saobana on'anima? Nandina : Atcha, indide anga da'o Nokman'- demechikchi re'angkuna. (Re'angna am'a) [ 50 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dhaniram Nandina Dhaniram : Nandina Dhaniram : Nandina Dakmesoka II [Mesokani If] Ei jong, chadengboching, ka'onange re'angna am'engjokma? Mingsa kattako knaangbo. (An'tangna agana) la kattako u‘itokode namjawaha. Da'o anga maiko dakgnok? Indiba ia gamchatgipa jakstemko maidake una

on'gen? - Maiko dakgen da'o? la jakstemko anga budi dakesa rajani jakoniko man'achim — chanchie da o maiko man'kugen? On'nan nangaig- nok. Oi sahep, na'ara grapengama? Ha....! Ha....! Ha....! (An'tangna agana) Aiao inmana! la chona bi'saan angko togiengaha? Che! Da'o maiko dakgnok? On'ataig- nok! Miksonge re'bagipa kam chu'sokode rajachiko da'oba maiba maiba boksisko man'angkugen. (Parake) la ra'bo, ha. Indiba, jong, ia kattarangni gimin darangba u'ijachina. (Jakstemko ra'chake) Ong'aigen — indide anga re'naha. (Mittino dongnue donga) (An'tangna agana) Re'ang sala bi'sa! Da'al angna sal bilongen namjaha. Ah! Je ong'na nanga ong'angjok. Anga da'o maiko dakgen. (Ong'katanga) (Dongnue dongaoni ong'katbae

an'tangna agana) Ha....! Ha....! [ 51 ] Oimbri Matgrik Dakmesoka tl [Mesokani II] Dhaniramni duk ong'ako nike ka'dingnasa skaia! Ha....! Ha .! Bilongen denggu, uni kri biteba man'aha! - Da'o mai ong'aha? lako kraa gitan sasti on'na nanggen, ong'jaode anga tom' tom dongna man'jawa. Da' ode angaba re'aignok. Da o anga me'chikni bimangc re'ange Nokman’ demechik Dimbriko grongekuna. Indiba anga una an'tangko maidake parakgen? (Dikdiksa chanchia gita dake) Ong'aigen, indaken namgen! Anga an'tangko Dumuiya a'songni rajan' demechikni ripeng ine tol'e aganna nanggen. Ian nambatgen. Ha ' Ha....! Ha....! (Ong'katanga) [ 52 ] MESOKANIIII Toromi Me'chik

Me'gam Nongal Toromi Me'chik Me'gam Nongal Manas Chibimani Rikam, Nokmani bari (Me'gam Nongal aro Toromi Me'chik napbaa) Rani, ia bilorigen kusini katta chong'mot. Dhubrini raja Saljagring ma'chongni bilakgipa matgrik ong'a. Raja Dhobani Dimbrini gimin mande watate uni Dimbrina ka'saengako parakaha. Dimbri baksa raja Dhobani krabebegen, ma'gapgen. ; Oe, krana ma'gapnaba donga, ia kattako jechakjaenga. : Anga knana man'a, ia rajani gamjin bilongen bang'bea; ua bilongen toromi aro saksa skia-pora man'gipa mande ong'a. : Nang'ni pattianichi da'ona kingking [ 53 ] Dimbri Matgrik

loiomi M?'chik Mt" gam Nongul 1 oromi Mechik Oakmesoka II [Mesokani III] pilakan name dongengpitti. Mikka balwa rakbajokode mongnalko bikpil bawil bil si bil'dak ong'ata; indiba balkasin balbajokode uni silani bilongen nitobaroroa! Gun grigipa seko man'ode silbegipa me'chikni nitoaniba an'tangtang dimelangaia. Gun grigipa me'asani jako nam- begipa me'chikba silna man'ja. (Chanchia gita dake) Anga ia demechik Dimbrini giminan chanchie gisiko bilongen duk man'a, gisik dongsiksakbea, ka'tong dongtoja. (Grapa) . Ma ani ka tongsajokona, dukde ong genan, gisik dongsiksakgenan. ; Abi, angni ia ka'tong chibolni mongnalko sana pakwatgen? Sawa

uko ra'anggen? Anga ia bi'sako chononian su'bu ki'i gale ging gale aldu-mittangbaaha; dal'atbaaha, uko anga maidake gipinni jako pakwat- gen? la bi'sani kopal rasongo maiko see donsoa donga? (Grapa) : Rani, ia pilakan ong'telaigipani niam ong'a. Bi'sa-de sadongode uamangna chanchien ma'a-paasa bilongen sko saani ong'a. Hai, re'bo, indaka kattarangko chanchie dongode cholijawa, da'o nokningchi re'naha. [ 54 ] Dimbri Matgrik Me'gam Nongal Dimbri Nandina Dimbri Nandina Dimbri Nandina Dakmesoka I! [Mesokan l(i< Haida, Nokmaba da'omangde kam matchotenggnok.

: Hai, re'bo indide. (Sakgnian ong'katanga) (Dimbri aro Nandina n ipba ;' : Aganbo ripeng. Nang'ni kattarangko knaede anga bilongen gisiko kenmana. Na'a indila duk man c ianona re'baaha, Nang na duk ong'chaka. : Nokman' demechik, jilgipa moina gringoni jokahaode, uni ki'sang ki'sang buringni do orang ja'rikpaa; angni obostaba indaken ong'aha- chim. Indiba nang'ni jajong mik- kangko nike anga ua pilak duk- rangko da'o gualaha. ; Nama ripeng. Nang'ni raja angni pagipaona mande watatgija nang ko- sa angona maina watatjok? : Chong' mot. Nokman' demechik, na'a bilongen budi gnanggipa ong'a. Na'a pilakkon ma'sia. Chong'motde, raja nang'ko sriksrik nibachinasa angko nang'ona watataha. : (Ka'onanga gnang) Maina? Maina angko sriksrik nichina nang'ni raja

nang'ko watata? Mai dorkama? : Maina ukode angaba aganna man'jawa. [ 55 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dakmesoka II [Mesokani III] Dimbri : Aiao inmeina! Anga knana man'a, ia nang'ni rajaan, angni jatko changsao, Dhubrio songdonga'chamitingo chonnike-mikchepe rikgalatachim, uno dongnan on'jachim. Ua raja baksa angni aro angni jatni maming nangnikani dongna nangja. Aganbo- ching, nang'ni rajani miksongara mai chong'mot? Angaba Dhubrion atchibaana. Angni atchiani salgipin- on angni jat gimikko Dhubrioniko rikgalatahana. Dhubrio atchiani giminsa angni bimingko Dimbri mingana. Anga ua rajana da'oba mitchikuenga. Nandina : Nokman' demechik, kema ka'bo, angni maming namgija miksongani dongja nang'ni kosako. Uni miko chiko cha'e-ringe janggi tang- paengani giminsan anga uni katta

gita uni ge'etako manina nangao ga'akenga. Ua angko nang'ko nina watataha; na'a mai rokom, uarang- ko niangchina ma'siangchinasa nang'ona watataha. Dimbri : Indide, na'a angko nikahakonba, da'ode re'ange aganebo, matgrikni demechik matgrik chong'motan ong a ine. Nandina : Nokman' demechik, anga nang'na tol'e aganjaenga. Nang'ko nikna skang anga nang'ni gimin gisiko jeko chanchiachim, angni chanchiana [ 56 ] Oimbri Matgrik Oakmesoka II (Mesokani III] bate na’a bilongen dingtang. Na'a matgrikni demechik ong'na krachong'mota, bimangni silachibo nang'ko a'gilsakni maming baksa tosusana man'jawa; ka'sroka ku'rang, rinoka mikron niani arsgko aiao inmanata. Dimbri : Kakketko aganboching, na'songn> rajara maidakgipa mande manch.j

Ua retrangna ka'saninggipama a'-u uni ka'saa namnika pilaknar,- apsanma? Nandina ; Nokman' demechik, uni kaitakf; maiko agangen. Bimangchide ua bilongen chananga, sila aro ka'saninga uni mikron. Ugita sila bimangko anga da'onaba darangko nikkujaenga. Uni sila aro chanan- gako gisik ra jokon gisik an'tesreng aro bimang an jrim dakbaaia. Indiba uni cholon bewal bilongen bikpil. Uni ka'tong bilongen ka'saninggijagipa ong'a. A'songni retrangko bilongen sinjetbea aro a'songni nomilrangko bilongen kal'akbea. Retrang kenesa chakchike dongaiengjok. Dimbri : (An'tangna agana) la me'chikni agangipa kattarang kakketan ong'naba donga. Kakket ong'a ong'ja maming dorkar dongja. Angni jatko namnikgijagipa rajako maming saloba anga olakkina man'jawa, (Parake) Atcha - da'ode anga [ 57 ]

Dimbri Matgrik Nandina Dimbri Nandina Toromi Me'chik Dakmesoka II [Mesokani III] re nakaha, angni ripengrang haiwa chibol rikamo angko senge dongsoengaha. Na'a da'oba basakoba re'bae angko grongbo. : De ong'aigen. : (On'tisa mikkangchi re'ange) Nibo, na'a gualnabe, na'a da'obatai re'babo; nang'o kattarangko sing'na nangani bang'bea. (Ong'katanga) : (An'tangna agana) Manderang Taposikosa silbea ine aganronga. Indiba raja ia silbegipa me'chikko nikahaode uko nina siktaigenma? Aiao inmanpile sila, indake silako anga da'ona kingking nikkujaenga. Indake sila me'chik a'gilsako dongbebeama ine chanchiman'a.

(Chanchia gita dake) Dhobani rajani watatgipa sipai dal'gipa haida da'omangde sokbaenggnok. Haiwa nikatengaha Nokma Dejangpa iachipaknan re'baengaha. Anga ia bol pangni mittino on'tisa chadenge nikuna. (Mittino chadenge dongnue donga) (Nokma baksa Me'gam Nongal aro Toromi Me'chik napbaa) : Nokma, Dhobani rajani watatgipa mandeni bimingko mai minga inachim? [58] Oimbri Matgrik Dakmesoka II (Mesokani III] Nokma : Oh, uni biming? Uni bimingko Dhaniram minga. la mande bilongen gun gnanggipa aro mikkangchikoba nikprotna man'soaigipa ong'a. Aro raja Dhobani an tangba seng'gipa mande ong'a, ua namani aro namgijaniba raja ong'a. Toromi Me'chik : Nokma, na'simangni kosako Rokkime aro Tatara Rabugani

pattiani pangnan ong'china. Nibo, mairongpile aiao inmanani katta! Je rajaan changsao Garorangko uni a'dokoniko rikgalatachim, ua apsan rajaan da'o uni mandeko watate mai budiko dakna mangsongenga? la pilak kattarang bilongen chanchina nangani katta ong'enga. Nokma : Chong'mot, ia pilak ong'anirang bilongen chanchina nangani ong'enga. Toromi Me'chik : Anga na'simangna ku'pattienga, na'simang pangna mikgaoe simake dongbo. Badia somoio mai a'selrang sokbaa uko warachakna pangnan simsake dongbo. Anga da'oba rongtalgipa biaprangchi re'angna nangkuenga. Na'simang pangnan simsake mikrake dongbo. Me'gam Nongal : Nokma, angade an'chingni demechik Dimbrinasa simbraenga. Ua da'ode [ 59 ] Dimbri Matgrik

Nokma Me'gam Non gal Nokma Dakmesoka II [Mesokani III] nomil sokaha. Una mikboke saobarang bobil dingjokode an'chingni demechikni obosta mai ong'gen. (Grapa) : (Jikgipani jakko rim'e) Rani, mamingnaba jajrengnabe; je Gitel an'chingko Tibetoni ‘A' song Pattari Chiga Suunchi-ona, unoni, A'song Saora Chiga Timbora’-ona, uni ja'man A'song Neng'gitu Chiga Neng'chibing’-ona aro unoni Manas chibimani rikamo donggipa Donkuta Grimkol, chong'motan da'o an'ching- ni dongenggipa biapona dilbaaha nirokbaaha, ua Gitelan da'oba an'chingko rama mesokangaigen. Uni gimin mamingnaba jajrengna nangja. An'chingko dilenggipa Mitdeo pangnan pangchakbo aro bi'bo, Uan jokatgen. Na'a grapnabeha.

: Demechikni mikkangko nie gisik dongtoja, bobilni jako ga'akangnasa anga kenbea. (Grapa) : (Ruutkale rang' spec) Rani, pattigipa Ra'rongipa sani kopal rasongo maiko see donsoa uko sawa ma'sia aro uko sawa gelna amgen? Chanchie nibo, na'a - anga da'o bano dongenga aro iana skang bano dongachim? Dakgipa Pattigipani niam indaken a'gilsako cholibaengaha. Badita a'bri, sagal, chibol, chiring, chibima, [ 60 ] Oimbri Matgrik Nokma Me'gam Nongal Toromi Me'chik Nokma Dimbri Me'gam Nongal Dakmesoka II [Mesokani III] buring, samring, bol, wa'a, jo'ong,

guk, mande aro matburingrang a'gilsako atchiaha siang-bon'angaha. Indake chengo chengonian jring- jrotoni jringjrotona bikpil bawil ia a'gilsako ong'baengaha, ong'aha aro ong'angkugen. larangni bidingo chanchie kene an'chingni maming lap dongja. Ong'gnigipa jegitaba ong'aigen. (Knatobee mittinoni git ring'a) ; Aiao bilongen knatobea git! : Nokma knabo, badita ka'srokbee git ring'enga. la bi'sani kopal rasongo maian sea donga chanchie anga gisiko suk ong'breja. (Grapa) : Rani, na'a indake duk ong'e mesoknabe. Nibo, nang'ni duk ong'ako nike Nokmaba duk man'paengaha. (Dimbri napbataia) ; Re'ba, ama Rani, Re'ba. ( Skoo ku'dime) : Baba, amaara maina indake dakenga? Ama, na'a maina grapen- ga?

: (Dimbriko ka'bakona salbae jak- samgnichi gipake) Ama rani, indita [ 61 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dimbri Nokma Toromi Me'chik Nokma Nokkol Nokma Nokkol Nokma Dakmesoka II [Mesokani III] salni ja'mansa na'a ia rasong grigipa nang'mako gisik ra'ama? Angni sawa donga, ama , nang'na agre angko ama ine okamnagipa? (Grapa) Maina ama? Nang'ko wate anga bachi re'anggen ama? (Grapa) Peleki gnanggipa songsaro ka'saa- ka'pakani bu'su badita saknaani ong'a, uko chakchikna nanggipasan u'iaia, mo abi? : Ong'chongmot; uni giminan

chengode Muni Risirang songsar- toromko wate, buringrangosa re'ange dongrongachim. (Nokkol napbaa) : Mai songbad, Ranggat? Na'a mai koborko ra'baa? : Nokma! Dhubrini raja da‘o saksa mandeko watataha, ua nokmikkango chadenge dongenga . : (An'tangna agana) Raja Dhobani da'oba angona mande maina watataha? (Parake) Atcha, Jaching- pako agansobo ua mandeko name dake rimchaksochina. Anga da'oan re'baenga. : Nang'ni ge'eta gitan ong'china, Nokma. (Ong'katanga) : Rani, hai an'ching nokningchi [ 62 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dimbri Megam Nongal Nandina . DakmesoKa II {Mesokani III]

re naha. Angade da'oba soba kutturiona re'angna nangengaha. : (An'tangna agana) Dhobani rajani mandeara maina re'baaha? Ma da'oba A'chikrangko sinjetna maiba budi dakengama? : Hai re'bo. (Toromi me'chikchipak nie) Abi, hai na'aba re'bo. (Pilakan ong'katanga) : (Mittino dongaoni ong'katbae) Aha! Ranini duk ong'ako nikjokode an'tangba duk ong'manaia. Saksa kam'kam demechikna ma'gipa pagipa ka'sajaode sana ka'sagen? Da'o a'gittal mande re'baa ingipara badia a'songni ukosa ma'sina man'kujaenga. Re'angpac nikuna ia a'gittal mandeara banoni maina mancha re'baa. Anga chanchia ia a'gittal mandcko Raja Dhobanian watatna nanga. Dhaniramko watate- ba da'oba dingtang mandeko watattaianiara mai orto? Anga da'o me'asani bimango dakjena nanggen. Dhobani rajanian mande ong'ode,

anga Dhaniramni gimin pilak kattakon agansrangaigen. lamangan me'chik jatkode mamingna cholija aro bilgri ine chanchigiparang ong'a. Indiba iamang me'chikni budiko ma'sikuja. Maiba u'isokgijagipa a'selni gimin ua biaponi katbana nangon, A'chik pagitchamrang dingtang dingtang chasongo eiro dingtang dingtang biap gitasa re'badilbaachim ine pagitchamrangni ma'ambi aganbaaoniko ma'sina man'a. Indaken pagitchamrang dingtang dingtang dilgiparangni bimingrangko minga. Salaram aro Salgipengchipeik Tsongdu chibimako batsotna dakenggipa A'chik pagitchamrang Ron Sadepa Nokma Chigatpa baksa gronggrikaha. A'chikremg ia Nokma Chigatpa beiksa hedda maibani a'selo melina nangrimna man'jachim,

ong'jaoba, A'chikrangni ka' donga aro bilak- wa'saako nike, mikkangchina kenchake, maibarango pa'sike, A'chikreingni bilgrimitingo, A'chikrangko ua biaponiko rikgalna budi [176] Dimbri Matgrik Aganchotani dakaha. Ua budi dakanio A'chik Nomil Dimbri, gipin jatni mikbokani sikar ong'aha.Dimbriko on'kangbaen A'chik pagitcham ma'gitcham- rang, ua ka'namgijagipa aro ka saninggijagipa Rori Sadepa Nokma Chigatpani jakoni jokbaaha. Jattangko chonnikarangko nike Dimbriba chakchikna man'jae, mandeni bimango matburing gisikni ua mandeko, budi dakskae, ka'samike, chu pekate so'otaha. Bebera'tojaoba indaken ong'chongmotachim ine bebera'na nangao ga'aka. Indake maiba a'selrang ong jaode, A'chikrang Tsongduko chobatbaani ja'manba ua nalsani rajarang A'chikrangko maina bobil dingbaachim ine darang chanchirakgipa A'chikrangni gisiko sing a nakataigen. Nalsaona bobil dake dingbagiparamgni gisepo Ron Sadepa Nokma Chigatpani bimingkode mingtaiako knana man ja. lani orto, Nokma Chigatpako Dimbri

so'otaha ine u'ina man'ani ja'mansa ua nalsani rajairang A'chikreingko (Dimbrini ma'kringko) mangkimaatna ine ka'kim chae Tsongdu nalsaonaba bobil dingbaachim. Rori Sadepa Nokma Chigatpa sijaode uaba Tsongdu nalsaona A'chikrangko bobil dingbapagenchim. Indiba ua bobilrang A'chikrangko mangkim- aatna man'angjaha, bikpile uamangsa A'chikrangna kene katangsdaha. Indiba dukni katta ian, A'chik Jatni salgisakni ching'begipa aski rongsa, bobilrangni [ 177 ] Dimbri Matgrik Aganchotani chri - bra watanio joksekjaha; uko baditaba chrirang uni chelo, janggilo nangeaha aro unon ua gitilgopaha, A'chik Jatna ma'ringe Manas rikamon ua ga'akgropaha. Dimbri Matgrik Tsongdu nalsachian sibaaha. Dimbriko ka'tongo gisik ra'esan A'chik Jat Tsongduko batsotna te'rik chap kagipao gatokaha. Me'gam Nongalde demechiknr' grapean sibokpilachim. Tsongduko chobatna A'chikrang salsni walsni nangaha. Nokma Chigatpako so'otaha ne knae Koch Biharni raja bilongen aiao inmanaha aro rang'san Dhobani raja baksa

ku'monge A'chikrangko bobil dingna Tsongdu nalsaonaba rikba-chabataiaha. Uamangko niksoe A'chik matgrikrang rang'san mi cha'ako dongale, mil'am sepi ra'bildange - me'a- me'chik nangrime bobilko warachaksona krimkro ku'cholsan ong'soaha. Dongdipgija salgittam walgittam chri bra watosa, mil am sepi ra'bildange chingsoosa Raja Bihari eiro Dhobani raja A'chik matgrikrangni ka'dongako nike, amchakjana kenchake katangpil'aiaha. Neng'take ia biapo misal cha'mitingo bobilrang baksa dakgrikna nangani gimin ia dg.kgrikram biapkon “Misal Cha'ram” ine mingaha. Misal Cha'ramoni bang'gija chel'aona jitange A'chikrang “A' song Neng'abat Chiga Neng'chibat” minggipa biapo dongeaha. Raja [ 178 ] DimbriMatgrik _ Aganchotan- Bihari aro Bijnini raja bolgni nangrime, adita sipairangko rimbitbae ia biaponaba A'chik- rangko bobil dingna rikbataiaha. A'chik matgrikraingni gisepo Chusinpa, Chuganpa, Olbin Kongdep, Baucheng Basuchengmang janggi jama galpile bobilko waracliaksoaha aro

ia dakgrikanio me'asarang baksa me'chik- rangba rimol sa'am pangpike, sok kanako dongale, mil'am sepi chakpile bilongen dakgrikpaeiha. Dolgninian bilongen an' chi pari ong'aha aro bang'en manderang siaha. Uni ja'man, Dimbrina ma'ringe aro dakgrikao sigipa matgrikrangna skime; adita salrangna chu cheke, wanti toke, ringe-cha'e salsni walsni ua biapo kalimkuaha. la dakgrikanio A'chik rangan bobilrangko amchepataha aro ia biapkon “Garo Mari Topla Khawa”-ine da'oba rr aigkuenga. Uni ja'man uamang salaramchi Tsongdu rikam joljol re'ange Ildek chisam Uolgomao, jekon A'chikrang “Dol jikjek jikjek, Gong mejek mejek, Roetara” ine mingachim, ua biapo re'ange dongeaha. Uanoniba mitamrang kosakchi doangkuaha aro bon'kamao Gua-a'te (Da'oni Guwahati) jolo, Saljongpatra, Rongdo'gachol, jeo Gaantini Ringringram Chiga Chironggini jinjinram a'song Kamagiriona sokeaha. Uni ja'mano, mitamrang Bokoni salgipeng jolo donggipa a'bri, Matcha Melaramo [ 179 ] Dimbri Matgrik Aganchotani

dongeaha. la biapoba uamang tom tom dongna man'jani gimin, saliramchipak mikkange antangtangni re'bagimin ja'kolko re'angtaiaha. Adita A chik dilgiparang Rong'mikseram Tangka Dakram aro Me'tongbol A'brio songdongeaha. Mitam A'chikrang Sambol Me'dikku, Amak Honda Turamo, A'song Dul Dokramo re'ange dongeaha. Indaken A'chikrang priprae dingtang dingtang biaprangona aro da'o A'chikrangni song- donga'chaenggipani ning'tugipa biap- rangonaba gipangaha jelangaha. Dimbrini ma'gipa Me'gam Nongal aro uni ma'kringrang haida da'oni Nongal jolona re'bae songdonga'chaachim aro maiba mingsa obosta (incident) ong'aonisa, ua biapko Me'gam Nongalni bimingchi ‘Nongal Bibra’ ine mingbaakon ine chanchiman'a. Ong jaode, ia ‘Nongal’ katta indinari maming ja'ting rikge gri chong'bana man'aijawa. North-East jolo songdonga'chagipa Tribalrangni gisepo A'chikrangan gnigipa jelbatgiparang ong'gen ine angni ripeng saksa angna aganachim. Uni kattako anga bang' a bebera'na man'jachim. Indiba jensalo

an'tangan a'songni iachi uachi re'na nangao ga'akaha aro gipin gipin a'songrangoba (State) A'chik songrang donga ine nikbaaha, unonisa anga angni jattangnijelako u'ina aro bebera'na [ 180 ] Dimbri Matgrik Aganchotani man'aha. Chong'motan A'chik jat jelbegipa jat ma'sa ong'chongmota, indiba indake jelgipa jatni maming ma'ambi ripingani dongja. Aganritingbagipa ma'ambirangniba maming j a' ting rikge donggija gita daknikman'aia. Assam, Tripura, Nagaland, West Bengal, Arunachal Pradesh aro Bangladeshoba A'chikrang donga ine ma'sina man'on, jattangna ka'pakman'ata aro ua pilak A'chikrangko apsan biapo songdongate, a'gilsakni manderangna A'chikrangba jelgipa aro bilakgipa jat ma'sa ine parakna man'genchim ine chanchiman'a. Indake jelbegipa jatniara ma'ambi dongama? Dongchongmota. Indiba indake sing'anina aganchakaniko gipinchiko man na ka'donggija, an'ching an'tangtangonikon man'a ama, indiba sakanti A'chikan on'tisa ‘Home work’ ka'na nangangkugen. Jattangna, A'doktangna aro

Ku'siktangna ka'saani, on'kangani sakanti A chikni ka'tong ning'oni an'tangtang nabana nanggen. Unosa, Somoi Nawangni Okningo A'chikraingni gimaae dongenggipa ma'ambiko, jatni rasong mikkimko, bilak-wa'saaniko, changa sapaniko, pilcikkon janerao nika gita jrojrange nikna aro A'chik Jatni chu'gimik Ma'ambiko bikote a'gilsakni manderangna rasong gnange mesokna man' gen ine anga ka'donga. Indiba A'chikrang bimehipangna aro [ 181 ] uimbri Matgrik Aganchotani Jattangni ma'ambiko ka'tongoni u'ina ka'oksigiparang ong'na nanggen. — Bon'aha— [ 182 ] Dear Mr. Sangma, Going through the two Plays has been a wonderful and enriching experience for me. The plots are wonderful and the concept is extraordinary. I applaud the fertile imagination you have manifested in your writing. The dialogue construction with rich vocabulary is terrific. Comparisons and use of Figures of Speech are enlightening, but on the heavy side. Too much use of comparisons sometimes takes a toll on the reader's patience. Otherwise, dialogues are lucid and catchy. Please take care during proof reading. Too many mistakes can mar the reader’s enjoyment. Wish you all the very Best 13 / 7/08 (Abi Re'nangma) B. K. Sangma

NEHU Tura Campusko kuliantal, songsarni golpoko segiparang bewalan nakatdapjok. Indiba Dakmesokaniko segiparang nangnikani kri baridapjaenga. Dakmesokaniko poraie gisik an senganiko u idapaniko man a. Indiba sa-attalo Dakmesokanirang an chingo dongsrangja gitan ong'aienga. Dongna gitaba maiko dakmesokgen? Segimin Dakmesokanirang bang'gijanian iani mingsa ja pang neng nikani ong-a. Indake ong-engo, Pa Prabodh M. Sangmani segimin "Dimbri Matgrlk” Dakmesokaniara balwa gital balnapbaa gita ong'a. “Dimbri Matgrlk* aganronggimal mite paksa, mande pil-sa ingipa gitan, Maambi pilsa ongna krakra banaidapani paksa daka. Bak ra-giparang ba Dakmesokanio Kal giparang mitama Maambio dongmanchagiprangan; mitamrangara banaidapgiparang.

A'chik Me*chik Dimbrina mai ong-chongmotachim, uko talsrange serikani dongja aro obosta chong-motko u*ina ja kol like ja*kol sane niachi tikkelaniba komia. landaka jajaarangni gisepo, Pa Prabodh M. Sangma an*tangni ong*na kranikgipako Ma'ambiming meliate ia Dakmesokaniko sea. Senokgipa an-tangan uni Aganchenganio Dimbrina ong'a a'selko chanchiatang p] gita dingtange ra-a aro Dimbriko A-chik Matgrik gita mesokna jotton ka a ine janapa. Me'chikrangna Bil-Jak on*na a gilsak gimikon tikkelmiting chachaon, me chikrangko skotong done, me-chikni gun-mikkimko golponi ja'pang bisring ra e Dakmesokaniko seaniara, A-chik me*chikrangna rasong chaani ong-a. A chikrangni Tibetoni katbamitingo, Achik me-bhikrang ramaoba nokdangni kam- bewalko ja rikkue, setangtangni bobil dingao dingpae, A-chikni ma-kringko mangkimaatjana jak on-paa baksana, A-chik me-chikni gun-mikkimko de-doaha. Ma-ambiko gualangenggipa, una gisik on-ani komienggiparangna ia Dakmesokani ding-chaoatani ong-chongmota. A-chikrangni skango janggi tangani, kam-bewal aro bebera-anirangko chasong gitalni Senokgiparangko

seachi ripinge donna ia ki-tap didiatgen ine ka-donga. Ia Dakmesokanio on-gipa ja-pang golpoko darang Ma-ambiko See Rakkianioba poraiman-jawa. Bisring dingsa man-akosa, Pa Sangma dokbadale on-jotdape sea. Gisiko wa-sae nilgagringgiminko ua katta me-suao donskaa. Agangrikatanirangoni mitamrang bakrooba, kattarang wa-saani gimin poraimitingo poraigipani gisikko cha-brangatjawa. Jakkalronggija kattarangkoba ia seanio jakkale uarangko tangchapilata. Pa Sangma songsarni golporangko bang-en seaha. Indiba Dakmesokaniko seanide ian jak on-chenggipa ine ua agana. "Dimbri Matgrik” baksana ua minggipin Dakmesokanikoba “Jugl SUchl” ine katta bichong on-e sea. Dakmesokaniko seani bewal da- ode una mikgimalangaignok; uni gimin bang-bata Dakmesokanirangko uni jakoniko ka-dongchaksoaniara ong-gramaijawa ine anga bebera-a. Schoolo, Collegeo aro Universityo aide ra’na man-nagipa aro skina kragipa seanirang^o bang’On nangeng^a. la Dakmesokani iani bidingo on’gilpana aro gipinran^o didiatna man*gen. Uni segimin "Dimbri Blatgrlk” Dakmesokaniko poraie nicheng giparangoni saksa ong*na aro ia

Do ga nitimgipa Bijnini Sipai dal gipa Dejangpani demechik Dimbrini Ma-gipa Mrik Rajani jikburing Raniko nirokgipa [Vi] MINGSA MINGGNI KATTA C hong- mo tde, A-chik ku-sikchi A-chik Jatni Ma-ambiko sea-jotachi maming ripingani dongbajani gimin, A-chikrangni Ma-ambini bidingo name tale ma-sina bilongen neng beani ong-a. Saobarang Dimbriko Songdu nalsachi nokkol dake donbaachim ine agana aro mitamrang nokkol dake ong-ja, indiba rajani jikgipa dakesa donbaachim ine agananiba donga. Mitamrang me chik sakprakna te rik pangprak dake sak ritchagittam me-chikrangko donbaa ine agana. Dimbriko je obostaoba donbachina, indiba A chikrang Songduko chobatbana skang ua Songdu nalsani rajarangna maiba ka-onangani ba uamangna maiba namgijagipa gisik saani kamko ka baachimkon ine chanchiman a. Uni giminsa A-chikrangni Songduko chobatbae neng take

misal cha-mitingoba Dhobani raja aro Koch Biharni raja bolgni nangrime A-chikrangko bobil dingbaachim, Songdu nalsaona rikbaachim. Bobilrangko niksoe A-chik Matgrikrang rang-san mi cha-ako dongale, mil-am sepi ra-bildange - me-a- me-chik nangrime bobilko warachaksona krimkro ku-cholsan ong-soachim ine A-chikrangni Ma-ambio aganani donga. Dongdipgija salgittam walgittam [vii] chri bra watosa, mil am sepi ra bildange chingsoosa, Raja Bihari aro Dhobani raja, A chik Matgrikrangni ka dongbeako nike, amchakjana kenchake katangpilaiaha. Misal cha-mitingo bobilrang baksa dakgrikna nangani giminan ia dakgrikram biapkon “MISAL CHA-RAM’ ine mingaha. Uni ja-man, A chikrang ua biaponi bang gija chel'kalaona jitange “A-song Neng-abat Chiga Neng'Chibat** minggipa biapo dongeaha. Raja Bihari aro Bijnini raja bolgni nangrime, adita sipairangko rimbitbae ia biaponaba A chikrangko bobil dingna rikbataiaha. A chikrang jama janggi galpile bobilko warachaksoaha aro ia dakgrikanio me asarang baksa me chikrangba rimol sa am pangpike, sok kanako dongale, mil am sepi

chakpile bilongen dakgrikpaaha. Ia dakgrikanio bilongen an chi-pari ong aha aro bang en siaha. la dakgrikanio A chikrangan bobilrangko amchepataha aro ia biapkon “GARO MARI TOPLA KHAWA” - ine da oba mingkuenga. Songdu nalsani raja A chikrangko Songdu chibimako chobatbachina inean te rik pang ritchagittamko kusi ong ean on atode ba on-atachim ong-ode, Songduko chobatbaani ja man A chikrangko ia nalsaonade bobil dake dingbana, rikba-chabana nangjajokchim. Indiba A chikrangni Ma ambi Agananio Songduko chobatbaani ja manba ua nalsani rajarang A-chikrangko bobil dingbaachim. Kusi ong ean Songduko chobatangchina ba chobatbachina ine A chik Pagitchamrangna te rik pang ritchagittamko [viii] on nata ong ode, Songduko chobatbaani ja man maina A chikrangko bobil dingbaachim? Maina? Maina bobil dingbaachim saoba aganna man genma? A chikrangni ka dongana, bilak wa saana, bamjana aro ka grakana mikkangchi kenchakesa, A-chikrangni bilgriengamitingo, A chikrangko mangkimaatna aro uamangni mikkangoniko chel atna miksongesa, Songduko

chobatbaani ja-manba bobil dingbaachimma? Ong jaode maina? la ‘Maina’ ine gisiko sing'a nakatani giminan ia Dakmesokanio ba Dramao Dimbriko dingtang dake mesokna jotton ka'aha. Ua saksa Matgrik chong'motchim. Rori Sadepa Nokma Chigatpani A'chikrangko onchep mikchepako aro chonnikako chaktojaenba Dimbri Matgrik uko budi dake so'otachim. Dimbri Matgrikni Rori Sadepa Nokma Chigatpako so'otani koborko man ne ua nalsani rajarang jajrengtokaha. Uni ja'man uamang baditaba bol rajarang tom dakc A chikrangko bobil dingbana ku'mongaha. Songduko chobatbaani ja-manba A-chikrangko bobil dingbaani a-selko ning-tue chanchiate niode, indaken ong-achimkon ine darangan chanchiman-aigcn. Rori Sadepa Nokma Chigatpa siahani giminan, songdu nalsaona A chikrangko bobil dingbataigiparangni gisepode uni bimingko knataina ba mingtaian dongjaha. Uni orto, uko A chik Matgrik Dimbrian so-otchong-motachim. Uni giminsa songdu nalsani rajarang Dimbri Matgrikni Jatko jakbikpilna aro mangkimaatna ine songdu nalsaonaba bobil [ix]

dingbaachim, a jak sokbaachim. Maina, a sel gride Songduko batsotbagimin A chikrangko bobil dingbaani maming a selko nikatna man ja. lani bidingo maming a selko ma ambi aganriting- baanioba agana dongja. Chong motan, Dolgoma gita Songduko terik pang ritchagittamko chap kae batsotbagipa A chikrangnade Dimbri Matgrik ‘Jokatgipa’ chacha ong aha. A chik Jat gimiknan Dimbri Matgrik rasong chaani ong-chongmota. Dimbriko ia Dakmesokanio ba Dramao saksa ka dongbegipa, Jatna kas aagipa aro Jatna ;in tangko on kanggipa Matgrik ong a ine mesokaha. Hai, Dramako poraiangna icicicic M Dakmesoka I MESOKANII Raja Montri Raja Bijni, Rajani nokdring (Raja Bijit Narayan, ja' man ja' man jako lekka ra'e Montri napbaa) : Ah: mai dikdar! Na'songara angko dikdiksaba tom tom neng takna

on jawama? Na an on tisa chanchie niboching. : Raja, ia a'gilsakko nikama nikjaenga; ia a'gilsak rokomari bosturangko chile chakchike jrip dongaienga. Na'ara maina indita dongsiksakenga, chakchikbo. ; Ha! Ha! Montri, a'gilsak baksa angko maichi tosusana man'a? A'gilsakkode indake chakchiknan Isol tariaha - indiba angade saksa chonbegipa mandesan ong'aia, cha'na-ringna, tusina-bamsina, somoi gita neng'tak- na - ia pilakrangko man jaode angna name janggi tangna neng'beani ong'gen. Niboda, anga da'o on'tisa [ 1 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dhaniram Montri Raja Dhaniram : Dakmesoka I [Mesokani I] aratengaha. la pilak lekkarangko attamchipak nina man'aigen;
