Na'a mikron mikchikon rakkina man'jaengaha! Da'o mai dakgnok. Indake grapgen ine ma'siode anga nang'na ia kattarangko aganjawachim; — uara Dhaniram iachipakan re'baenga. Nibo ripeng, na'a ia a'seloni naljokna skode uni ramakosa am'angbo. Mikron mikchichide maming kam chu'sokna amja. Nang'ni mikron mikchiko nike nang'ko raja gisik ra'genma ma Dhaniram kengen? : Hai ripeng, an'ching ianoni on'tisa

jite chadengna. Haiwa Dhaniram re'baengaha. Nina, ua ianona re'bae maiko daka? (Mittinao dongnua) (Dhaniram napbaa) (An'tangna agana) Ha....! Ha....! Ha....! Montri ang baksa sipairangko watatpana skaan dongsrangjachim; indiba indaka budiko dake bon'kama- ode angni namnika gitan dakna nangaiaha. Ha....! Ha....! Ha....! Rajaba ong'bo montriba ong bo, Dhaniramni ja'gao ga'akna pilakan nangtelaigen! Dhaniram kamtangko maming saloba gualja! Da'o sipairangna chamgipa tangkako jako man'chengna nanggen; uni [ 20 ] Oitnbri Matgrik Dakmesoka I [Mesokani II] ja'man, ramarango jeko man'a uarangkoba watjawa. Indita sipai- rangko ang baksa watatpaenga, angna mai kenani? (Chanchia gita dake) Taposina ka'sa-ka'paka rajani ka'tongoni sal salna chel'ang- rikrikengaha. Da'oara maina? Uade

da ode angko mamingchiba dak- chakna bil man'jawaha, dongjaha. Indiba ia me chikba bilongen silade sila. Jeba ong'bo, changsa ukoba grongangsrangna. (Parake) Bao? Taposi bachi, bano? Bao darangba maina aganchakjaenga? (Taposi napbataia) Taposi : Mai, Dhaniram? Maiko chanchie re' baa, aganboching knana? Dhaniram : Maiko chanchigen? Nang'ni sila- nitoani giminan gisiko chanchienga- chim. Taposi : Angni sila nitoani gimin? Indake toTna sawa nang'na skiaha agan- boching? Dhaniram : Sawa skigen, angni mikron rong- gnian angna skiaha. Taposi : De! De! Oi Dhaniram, na'a da'oro- rode bilongen bal'ekna changgipa me'asa ong'baengaha, mo? Dhaniram : Ong'jaode mai ong'gen? Nikjama, Tatara Rabugani ge'etako man e Nostu-Nopantu a'gilsako, aski- [ 21 ]

Dimbri Matgrik Dakmesoka I [Mesokani II] tanoriko dakaha - - angaba nang'ni nokkolsan ong'a - ge'etaibo maiko dakna nanga. Taposi : Nama Dhaniram, namen nama, knaman'enga na'a saoba me'chikni kingsa noksako rajana hajal kolgrikbongana palahana, ong'ama ong ja? Dhaniram : S sawa nang'na ia kattako aganjok? Taposi : Jeba aganchina. Indiba ia kattara kakket ong'ama ong'ja? Dhaniram : Ong'ja tol'asa. Indaka kattako sawa nang'na aganjok? Na'aba saksa! Da'ororo hajal kolgrikbonga tang- kako sawa sana indinari on'aigen? Taposi : (Dhaniramni gangipa jakstemko nike) Are, iara mai? Na'a ia gamchat- gipa jakstemko banoniko man'jok? Dhaniram : (An'tangna agana) Ah! la me'chikara ong'ai ong'jai kattarangkosa sing e roengaha da'oara? (Parake) la jakstemko raja name tarie donchina

angna on'aha. Taposi : Bebema? Ong'bebeankon! Nama, Dhaniram, mikka wajokode chibol jegita chiko chimonge rakkia, uandake na'aba rajani maiba bosturangko man'ode simsake rakkironga, ong'ama ong'ja? Dhaniram : Ong'naba donga, sawa u'ia? Na'a mai maiko aganenga angade ma'sinan [ 22 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dakmesoka I [Mesokani II] man'j aengaha. Taposi : Maidake ma'sina man'gen? Nang'gita dake sontolbegipa mande saoba banoba dongama? Anga indakesa aganachim, je a' ran kario ran'kreke donggipa chibolba mikka chiko man'ahaode chiko chimonge rakki- ronga, na'aba rajani maiba bosturangko man'ode indaken rakkironga, ong'ama ong ja? Uarang jeba ong'china; mingsa kattakosa anga nang'o sing'na skengachim - chong'motan - na'ara Manas rikamo

songdongenggipa Nokman' demechik baksa rajako bia ka'e on'na jotton ka'engana, ia kattaara kakketma? Dhaniram : (An'tangna agana) A'i maidakesa! la matcha bimara ia pilak kattarangko maidake u'itokaha, knaaha? Taposi : Mai ong'aha, maina katta agangija jripjrip dongenga? Dhaniram : Atcha, nang'na indake tol a kattarangko sawa aganjok? Taposi : ToTa? Anga nang'ni chalakki daka budirangko indita sal nirikkie ma'sina man'aha; na'a ang baksa je bewalko mesokaha aro je kattarangko aganaha, ia pilak kattarangko raja knaode, nang'ko Manas rikamo songdongenggipa Nokmaona watat- gija, Chitmangonasa watatgenchim! la kattako na'a u'iama u'ija? [ 23 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dakmesoka I [Mesokani II] Dhaniram : Na'ade indake agangenan da'ode. Nang'ni maming dos dongja. Indakaan ia chasongni torom ong'a! Ian chasong gital ong'a. la chasongo

dakchakgipakon cha'sotani chasong ong'a. Na'a an'tangni giminan chanchie nichengbo, na'a maichim aro da'o mai ong'aha! Da'o na'a rani chacha gita suk ong'e janggi tangna man'enga; iara sani dakchakachi, gualahama? Da'o na'a angko cha'sotna jotton ka'jaode sawa ka'gen? Na'aba saksa ia chasong gitalni me'chikan ong'ajokna. Taposi : Oe - angaba ia chasong gitalni me'chik ong'a! Indiba na'aba chasong gitalni togirakgipa saksa Saitan ong'a. Na'a angko angni batanggimin salni kattarangko gisik ra'ataha, indiba na'a an'tangba on'tisa an'tangni gimin chanchie niboching. Na'an tangkana mikboke angni cholono kakketani toromko nosto ka'chenggipa ong'ama ong'ja. Anga kangalni demechik ong'oba kakket cholonon janggi tangen- gachim. Da'ode, Dhaniram, na'an aganboching, badia denggu mande ia dos grigipa do'oko rim e ra'bae ia

pattok gita dakgipa sonani gringo donenga? (Grapa) Dhaniram : (An'tangna agana) la me'chikna pilak kattarangko aganade kraani [24J Dimbri Matgrik Taposi Dhaniram : Taposi Dhaniram : Mittinoni : Dhaniram : Dakmesoka I [Mesokani 11] ong jawa, ua bang'bata kattarangkon ma'sitokaha; una agreba, raja ia kattarangko knana man'jokode obostaan namsrangjawa. (Parake) Knabo, Taposi, anga da'ona kingking nang'na maming namgijako daka dongkujaenga, jeko dakengoba anga nang'ni namgninan dakkuenga ; na'a angni kosako indinari maina ka'onangenga? Indide rajana bia ka'ani kattako sawa nakatchengata?

Uko anga maidake ma'sigen? Maidake ma'sigen? Na'an iani ‘dalali’ •ka'enga, na‘a ma'sijaode sawa ma'sigen? Ha! Ha I Ian na'song me'chikrangni ma'sisokgijagipa gisik ong'a, budi bakkandikani ong' a! Anga ‘dalali’ kamko ka'na nangengaha nang'ni namgnini giminan! Na'a bebera'jama anga ‘dalali’ ong'e re'angahaode ia bia maming saloba ong'jawa ine? Iani bidingo na'a tom'tom jajrenggija dongaibo! Iani ja'mansa na'a ma'sigen, Dhaniram nang'ni badita nambatgipa ripeng ong'a. Knajokma, Dhaniram ia noko dongama? Raja uko changsa grongna am'engana. Ua knabo! Anga da'o ianoni re'nakaha. Na'a iarangni gimin [ 25 ] Dimbri Matgrik Taposi Nandina Taposi

Nandina Taposi Oakmesoka I [Mesokani II] on'tisaba mamingnaba jajrengnabe. Raja ua me'chikko kimoba, angni tangenga dipet na'a mamingnaba jajrengna nangja. Nang'ni ia chadambeni bimang, rajani gamjin ong'a. (An'tangna agana) Nang'ni sila bimangko ra'ean dongbo, anga nang'ni skoon narikelko dokpretna rc'angengaha! (Ong'katanga) (Rang'spee an'tangna agana) Da'o rasong kopalo maiaan sea donga mamingkon ma'sina man'ja. Bao? Raja da'asalde angona re'bachipjaha. (Nandina napbataia) Mai rokom ripeng? Anga jeko agana ua kakketkonba? Indiba da'o iani gimin maiba chol dongama? la bia ong'ode, na'ade jringjrotna saksan sikdikdik janggi tangna nangaignok. Mai chol donga aganbo. Choi donga. Mamingna jajrengnabe.

Dhaniram chanchienga una bate chalakkigipa darangba dongja, indiba da'osa ua ma'sina man'gen uni badita mancha budi donga. Hai re' bo, ang baksa re'bapabo. Bigita dakgipa dengguko togina maming neng'nikani ong'jawa. Hai indide. (Sakgnian ong' Katanga) 126 ] Dakmesokaii MESOKANII Me'gam Nongal Toromi Me'chik Manas Chibimani Rikam, Nokmani Nok (Me'gam Nongal aro Toromigipa Me'chik napbaa) Abi, angni dukni kattako maiko sing'enga, maiko knagen! Anga tange dongenga, iaba Rengsa Balsa Salgrani ka'saachisa ong'a! Maiko dakgen, Nokmani mikkangko nik- jokon angni ka'tong dongsiksakbea!

Abi, chinga mai papko dakmanaha, Gitelba chingko keleng mikronchisa niengaha! Rani, na'a saksa daito gnanggipa Nokmani jikgipa ong'a! Na'a indake gisik-ka'tong be'grue mesokode maidake choligen. Rokomari a'sel- rangko chagrongna nanganian ia songsami niam ong'a. Basakoba suk, basakoba duk, basakoba kusini, basakoba sintiani, iarangan gelna [ 27 ] Dimbri Matgrik Me'gam Nongal Toromi Me'chik Me'gam Nongal Dakmesoka 11 [Mesokani I] galna man'gijagipa songsarni ripeng ong'a. Raja-Rani ong'ahaode, uamang Jringjrotna sukkosan man'aigen indake ong ja. Nibo, je manderang sagal gita songreenga,

uamangba pangnade tom'tome re'angna man ja! Badita stil, badita balraka, badita mikka, balminduri uamangni songreaniko champenga, uarangni maming hisap dongja. (Rang' spec) Abi, ua mikka balwako jean nikaha, uasan ma'sina man'gen ua badita kengnini ong'bea. Na'a chingni namgija obostarangni gimin knaode, indide Rani, angade jringjrotna an'tangko Gitelna on'kanggipa me'chiksa ong'a. la songsar sagalni bilakbegipa chipakkore aro dukni balminduriba angko maming dakeba moatna man'ja. Indiba (Bilongen rinokbea ku'rangchi) Maiko agangen abi, Nokmani mik- kang bimangko nikjokon a'gilsako tange dongna sikjaha. Uni nitobea bimang, chananga mikkang, roko- mari obostarangko chagrongna nangani gimin bilongen ong'sibeeng- aha! Ian Isolni donsogimin sal somoichimma?

[28J Dimbri Matgrik Toromi Me'chik Me'gam Non gal Toromi Me'chik Me'gam Nongal Oakmesoka II [Mesokani I] : Rani, nitogipa bimang wa'alni ding'ako man'ode bate rong- chingbate nika. Asol sonako wa'alchi so esa ma'sina man'a. Na'simangni da'o duk chakna nanganirangba uandake mikkangchi na'simangni rasong mikkimko teng'suatgen mingsingatgen. Duk aro rokomari saknaarang baksa dakgrike janggi tangbagipa manderangan ia song- sarni asol ortoko ma'sigiparang ong'a aro uamangan kakketgipa mande ong'na ama. . Abi, indake Nokma ong'e songsaro

janggi tangana bate buring samringo rorame, nokantio gilame cha'an, janggi tangaan jringjrotna kusini ong'batgen ine chanchiman'a. A'songni Nokma ba Raja ong'aniba sao sarapsa ong'a abi. : Oe - ong'ade ong'an. Atcha, Rani, nang'o mingsa katta sing'gen ine gisiko chanchie dongengachim; uara, demechik Dimbrini giminara na'simang mamingkoba chanchi- kujaengama? Uniba chu'onga gitan bilsi ong'aha. : Maiko chanchigen? Nokmaniara iarangni bidingo chanchiani somoi [ 29 ] Dimbri Matgrik Toromi Me'chik Me'gam Nongal Toromi Me'chik Me'gam Nongal

Toromi Me'chik Dakmesoka II [Mesokani I] jako dongama? (Rang'spee) Abi, nang'na maiko agangen, anga an'tangba iarangni bidingo Nokma baksa golpona-aganna somoian man ' srangj aenga . : lara mai katta? Indaka kamo gisik nanggija dakaniara kraani ong'eng- ama? Haiwa Nokmaara iachipaknan re'baenga. : Abi, changsamang Nokmani mikkang bimangko niate niboching! O I sol: la A'chik jatko Nawangni minokeng- aoniko basako na'a naljokatgnok? Badita chasong indake duk chake dongna nanggnok? (Grapa) : Rani, tom'tombo. Nang'ni ia somoio indake dongsiksake mesokani kraani ong'jaenga. Nang'ni indaka obostako Nokma nikeode baditan duk ong'gen, uarangni giminba chanchie nibo. : Abi, Nokmani indaka obostarangko

nikjokode anga a'gilsako janggi tange dongnan sikjaha. O Isol: Anga badia chasongo mai papko dakmanachim, na'a angko indita sasti on'engara? (Grapa) : (An'tangna agana) Is! Setangni dukko nike setangna ka'sachongmotgipa [30J Oimbri Matgrik Nokma Nokkol Nokma Nokkol Nokma Nokkol Nokma Dakmesoka II (Mesokani I] me'chikara tom'tom dongna man'genma? (Parake) Rani, na‘a da'o on'tisa jite chadengbo, on'tisa tom'tomani ja'man Nokma baksa agangrikna man'gen. (Ranini jakko rim'e) Hai, an'ching sakgnian on'tisa dang'dange chadenge dongna. (Mittinao chadenge donga)

(Nokkol baksa Nokma Dejangpa napbaa) : Ranggat! - : Maina Nokma! : la chittirangko Dingganni jako on'ebo aro aganbo, ia pilak chittirangni aganchakaniko da'alan tarie watatna nanggen. Ta'rake re'anggalgalbo. : Nang'ni ge'eta gitan ong'china, Nokma. : la chittirangna maidake aganchakna nanggen ua pilakkon anga chittini janggilo kan'dik kan'dik seataha. : Nang'ni ge'eta gitan ong'china, Nokma. (Ong'katanga) : (An'tangna agana) O Gitel Isol, anga Nokma ong'eba bilongen duk ong'esa jattangko nirokna aro janggi tangna nangao ga'akengaha. Angni jatko anga maidake basako tom'tome dongdil-cha'dilna man'gnok Gitel, angna nama ramako mesokangpabo. [ 31 ] Dimbri Matgrik

Toromi Me'chik Nokma Toromi Mc'chik Nokma Toromi Me'chik Nokma Toromi Me'chik OakmesoKa II [Mesokani fl : (Mittino dongaoni ong'katbae aro Nokmani mikkangona re'ange) Nokma tangbangchina. : (Salam ka'e) Abi, ruuta salni ja'man nang'ko grongna man'e anga bilongen kusi ong'a, indiba raniara bachi, uko iano maina nikjaenga; ua nang'miii- re'bapajama? : Oe, ua ianon dongachim, haida ua da'oan re'bataigen. : Abi, na'ara indita sal bano dong- achim? Bachi re'angachim? : O - anga? Anga Balpakram,

Chitmang aro Kamagiriona re'ang- achim. Nokma, nang'ni pilak mande- rangan namtokengakonba? : la da'o nikenga gitan. Gitel Tatara Rabugani pattiachi, Susimeni ka'saningachi da'ona kingking namen dongkuenga. Indiba iani ja'man mai ong'gen ukosa aganna man'ja. : Nokma, indake aganmalama? Chiring Chibimara basakoba a'bri-a'ronggako gelna aro galna man'ama? A'bri - a'rongga donga dipet chiring-chibimaba donggen. Jabitchimni ja'man jagital, jagitalni [ 32 ] Dimbri Matgrik Me 'gam Nongal Nokma Nokkol Nokma Dakmesoka II [Mesokani I] ja'man jarambong; indaken pang- nanade jabitchim ba jarambong

ong'aride dongkamaija. Mandeni janggi tanganioba indaken ong'a. Na'a mamingnaba jajrengnabe. Nang'ni jat bilongen ka'donggipa jat ong'a. Indiba ua ka'donganiko budichisa jakkalna nanga. Na'a jajrengani gisikko ka'tongona ra'banabe. (Me'gam Nongal napbataia) Re'ba, rani, re'babo. (Nokmani jakko rim'e) Gitel, indita salni ja'man changsa nokningchi re'e neng'takode bilongen kusi ong'begenchim. Rani, anga nang'ni mikkango bilongen oniako dakmana gita daknikman'enga; gisik ra'jokode bilongen kratcha'miina. Indiba maiko dakgen ? Anga maming saloba ska tang dos ka'a dongja. Hai re'babo rani, asongbo. (Toromi Me'chikchiko niate) Abi, na'aba ka'sapae asongbo. (Pilakan asonga) (Nokkol napbataia) Toromigipa Nokma, montri ia chittiko

nang'ona watattaiaha. Bao? Nina. (Chittiko poraie) Ah! Indita salni ja'man haida an'ching da' ode tom'tome dongna man'gnok. (Nokkol ong'katanga) [ 33 ] pakmesoka It [Mesokani I] Dimbri Matgrik Me'gam Nongal : Raja, iara maidake ong'gnok? Nokma : Bijnini skotong baksa songgi- grikaniko dakna am'engaha. Ua ia chittio indake ku'rachakaha je, una lak chibongamang dangga on'atode ua maming dakgija re angpilaigen. Rani, inda' a songbadko man'e angni ka'tongo .vusi aro duk ong'beaha. Bilakgipa mikka balwa gita dakgipa bobil ia a'songoni re'angaha, ia bilongen kusini a'sel ong'oba, indiba jeko on'atani ja'man ua re'angaha, uko gisik ra'jokode a'gilsako dikdiksaba janggi tange dongna sikjaha. (Rang'spee) Maiko agangen, anga mingsinggipa matgrikni

ma'kringo atchigipa ong'oba, saksa denggu mikbokrakgipana kene una dangga on'esa janggi ta>igna nangengaha. Che! lana bate angna maia kratcha'beani ong'na man'a? Toromi Me'chik : Nokma, pilakkonna'ama'sia. Paisani pil'sa pil'gni ba mikkang janggil donga gitan, mandeni janggi tang- anio suk-duk, sal ding'a salakkima, iarang pilakan donga. larangan Gitelni donsogimin a'gilsakni mandeni janggina rasong kopalni kal'ani ong'a. : Oe, ong'ade ong'an; iarangko darangba gelna man ja. [ 34 ] Nokma Dakmesoka II [Mesokani I] Dimbri Matgrik Me'gam Nongal ; Bijni rajani sipai dal'gipa dangga man'e an'tang sipairangko rime songtangchi re'angpilaha - iara Tatara Rabugani skanichian ong'a.

Nokma : (Ka'dingsmite) Rani, na'ara chan- chiama, ua denggu re bataijawaha ine? Menggoara changsa dutni similako manjokode, ua biapko indinari ramram watangaigenma? Dan gg a paisa nangjokode ua da'oba re'bataiaigen, iako jajrenggijan agansona man'aigen. Mikkangchide haida maimaikon bi'a sawa ma'sia. Chu'onga gita sipai, gure, mongma aro ostrorang dongode bil susaesa nisrangna skengjokchim anga, indiba bilgri ong'ani giminsa sko choknoke chakchikna nangao ga'akengjok. Toromi Me'chik : Nokma, na‘a iarangni bidingo bang'e chanchina aro jajrengna nangja; kosako donggipa Gitelan mikkang ki'sang pilakkon u'isogipa ong'a, uan nang'ko mikkangchi dakchakanggen. Me'gam Nongal : Nokma, namgija sal somoi batanga gita ong'aha. Da'ode an'chingni demechik Dimbrini giminba on'tisa

chanchina nangao ga'akengaha. Unaba jora-ripeng sandie on'ani somoi ong'engaha. [ 35 ] Oimbri Matgrik Dakmesoka II [Mesokani I] Nokma : lani gimin indita adik sikdik dakna nangja. Me'gam Nongal : lara mai katta, Nokma? Demechik dal aha, uko indinari rakkie donna man'aigenma? (Mittinoni doka-dam‘a gam'a, adita cherkalaoni) Nokma : Ah? Bah! Bilongen knatoa. Indake doka-dam'anirangko sawa dakenga? Me'gam Nongal : (Niate) Ua niatbo, demechik Dimbri uni ripengrang baksa pul bario roramenga. Toromi Me'chik : Ah, raja, niatboching, mite me'chik uni ripengrangko rime roramenga gita nikatpilenga. Me'gam Nongal : Nokma, nang'ni ia silbegipa mong- nalko saoba drae ra'e katangako na'a

namnikgenma? Nokma : Ua maidake ong'gen. Rani? Me'gam Nongal : Nokma, Delhini raja ong'jaoba gipin a'songni rajarang ia silbea mong- nalni gimin ma'sina man'ode uamang wataigenma? Nokma : Aiao! Maidakgipa knatobea ku'rang! Mittinoni : Git Knatobea ku'rang uni Ka'tong ka'srokani [ 36 ] Oimbri Matgrik 1 . 2 . 3 . Toromi Me chik Nokma Me'gam Nongal Toromi Me'chik _ Dakmcsoka II [Mesokani IJ Re'baenggipa salrang

Ong'ata chanchiani. Ka'tong da'al dongdikata Mainaba gisiko Man ja dongdipatna da'al Ka'tong su'dikako. Gitel na'a bilakatbo Sngni bilgriako Mesokangbo angna Janggini ramako. Nikna man ja dikdiksaba Janggini bimangko Dongjaha kakket bichalan la a'gilsako. : Aiao mairongpile knatobea! Nokma, chinga buring jatchio basakoba basakoba indaka knatobea gitrangko salgisako knana man'ronga! Indaka knatogipa ku'rang mite me'chiknisa ong'na kraa. : Oe, ong'bebean! Knatobebean! Jeba ong'bo rani, atcha an'chingni demechik Dimbrini bilsi da'o badita ong'aha? : Ah! Na'a gualahama Nokma? Dimbri da'ode chicheto ga'dapeaha.

: Nokma, da ode sal somoirang bilongen dingtangbeaha, skangni [ 37 ] Dimbri Matgrik Nokma Me 'gam Nongal Toromi Me'chik _ Dakmesoha II [Mesokani I] chasong gita ong'jajok. Dimbrina mande am'na inode jattangni gisepon matgrikrangko am'na nanga. : (Ruutkale rang'spee) Abi, maiko agangen! Chengo ambi-atchurangni songdonga'chabaani kattarangko gisik ra jokode bilongen gisiko suk ong ja; an'chingan bilak-wa'sagipa ka donggipa jatchim, uko da'o bebera'nan neng'angpilengaha! Indita sila aro sontola nomil banoba dongama? Anga buringo wa'al so'e donangengaha. Uamang ia wa'alchi kamchina - indiba Gitel, Nokman' demechikko name tom' tome rakkibo, ian angni nang'o bi'ani. Da'ode anga re'nakaha. Dhaniramna skangan Dumuryaona sokna nanggen.

(Ong'Katanga) *** [ 75 ] MESOKANIII Manas Chibimani Rikam, Nokmani bari (Toromi Me'chik napbaa) Toromi Me'chik : (An'tangna agana) Aiao inmana! Anga Balpakramo dongmitingo changsao Mahadevni Mandiro tusina nanga- chim; unon anga Dimbrini gimin namgija jumangko nikachim. Ua jumang gitan Dimbrini kosako ong'na am'engahama? O Gitel, ia pilakan nang'ni skao pangchaka. Dimbrini rasong kopalo mai dongsoenga, Gitel na an ma'sia. Dimbri jegita bimangchi sila, uandake ka'tongchi bilongen rinokgipa ong'a aro ka'donggipa gita uni gisik mangraka. Ua ramram mamingna kengijagipa nomil. Nokmani demechik ong'nan krachong'mota. Anga da'o raniko am'angkuna.

(Ong'katanga) (Dimbri napbaa) [ 76 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dimbri Me'gam Nongal Dakmesoka III [Mesokani II] : (An'tangna agana) Nandinara bachi re'angjok? Ma do'o pil'e bile katjokma? Anga uko am'na iachi uachi mande wataha. Aiao inmana! Uara peleki changama? Angade meimingkon ma'sina man'jaengaha. O gisik! Maina indita dong- siksakenga? Walni jumangara basakoba mikgittalo chu'sokgenma? la me'chikara angko togiangahama? Togiangaha ine maidake agangen? (Chanchia gita dake) Angni ka'tongni kattarangko Nandinana aganara kraani ong'ahama? Gisikni katta- rangko donnue donaba namade ong ja. Jo'ongrang jegita balchom- bamiting pulko chikprue a'palona

ong'katbaa, gisikba indaken ong'a. Haiwara ma jong, ang' ma'gipa baksa iachipaknan re'baengaha katta agangrike. Haida uamang angni giminan agangrikbaenga. Angni kopal rasongo Gitel maikon see donsoenga,ukosa mamingkon aganna man ja. Amamangni ianona sokbana skang anga ianoni re'angan nambatgenkon. Anga da'o git ring'gipa nokdringona re'angkuna. (Ong'katanga) (Me'gam Nongal baksa Toromi Me'chik napbaa) : Maiko agana, abi? Na'a ia kattako Dimbrini ku'sikonikon knaeima? [ 77 ] Dimbri Matgrik Toromi Me'chik Me'gam Nongal Toromi Me'chik M'egam

Nongal Toromi Me'chik Me'gam Nongal Toromi Me'chik Dakmesoka III [Mesokani II] : Oe, chong'mot. Ua an'tangan agana. : Aiao inmana! : Rani, kratcha'an nomilni ka'tong nokdringo ganding chinding ong'a. Saobani ka'tongni kattako bikotani- ara altua kam ong'ja. Anga budi dakesa uni kattarangko bikotna man'aha, uko nang'na maiko agangen? : Uni giminsa ia bi'sani mikkang bimangko maibana chanchibee donga gita pangnan nikenga. Ua maikon gisiko chanchie dongsimenga mamingkon ma'sina man'jaenga. : Rani, ia pilak kosakni skasa ong'a. Ua salmikkang pulko nikakonba; ia pul balgaoode salchipak mikkangesa

balronga, indiba maina indake ong'a, uko darangba aganna man'ja. : Salgra Saljongni teng'suana ua pul salnian nokkol ong'aha. : Rani, gisikni mikronchi mande maiko nikna man'ja? (An'skita gita dake) Aiao mairongpile dingchike similbaenga, rani, niboching, ia [ 78 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dakmesoka III (Mesokani II] similbegipa dingchikpile balwa baksa balbaenga. la similani badia puloni re'baenga, uko an'ching nikna man'ja. Indiba an‘ching gisiko chanchichipe ra‘na man'a je, ia pul haida bilongen silgipa pul ong'na nanga. Ua similanian jripjrip an'chingna uko atchiatgipa pulni gimin parakenga. Rani, rasongni pulniba, ma'sibo, indaka niaman ong'a. Me'gam Nongal : Chong'mot, kakket ong naba donga. (Mittinoni doka dam' a) Toromi

Me'chik : Nibo rani, Nokman' demechik gisiko maiko chanchia, uko ua da'oan parakaigen. (Mittinoni knatobea gitko ring'a) Toromi Me'chik : Bah! Karirangni raja Balrorokari sokbajokode do'kuako saoba jrip dongatna man'genma? Ua an'tangni ka'tongni kusikc sal wal mikoachi buringrango parakna jotton ka'a. Janggin' Balrorokari sokjokode mande jatni ka'tongoba uagitan jripjrip dongaina man'ja. M'egam Nongal : Ua jeba ong'china. Abi, nang'ni kattako knae angni ka'tong bilongen kusichi paksataha; uko anga kattachi [ 79 ] Dimbri Matgrik Toromi Me'chik Me' gam Nongal Toromi Me'chik

Me'gam Nongal Dakmesoka III [Mesokani II] parakna man'jawa. Indiba anga an'tangko bilongen rasong grigipa ine chanchiman'enga. Chanchi- achim saksa kamkam demechikna nama chawariko man'e on'na man'gen; indiba da'o nikengaha, ua pilakan indinarisa ong'aignok. (Grapa) ; Maina, Rani? Maina ong'gramaigen? : Abi, na'a maiko chanchienga, Nokmara demechiktangko ua Dhobani rajana on'genma? Ua rajade A'chikrangko rikgalgipa, A'chikrang- ni bobilsa ong'a. ; Ong'ana mai ong'jok! Chio ripchenggipaan Sagalni nambatgipa muktako man'na amaiama? liidaka katta ong'na amja, rani? Demechik na'simangni, na'simang sana on'na ska, umingan bia ka'e on'na man'a; iani bidingo maming mikkang ja'manni katta ong'na nangja.

: (Rang' spec) Abi, chingara ska tang dakna man'aiama. - Bah! Abi, iachipakko niatboching. (Mikkang- chipak ja'ku de'ange) Re'ba, ama rani, re'ba (Dimbri napbataia) [ 80 ] Oimbri Matgrik _ Dakmesoka III [Mesokani II] Na'a da'al maina duk ong'enga gita dongenga? Dimbri : Bao! Maina duk ong'gen? Me'gam Nongal : lara mail Na'a maina grapenga, rani? (Dimbri Mamingko agangija ma'gipa- ni gitoko gipake grapa) Me'gam Nongal : Che! Ama, che! Maina? Nang'na maiko nanga, na'a indakc duk ong'enga? Toromi Me'chik

: (An'tangna agana) Janggin' Balrorokari ka'tongo sokjokode indaken ong'ronga. Gisiko mik- songani chu'sokjana kingking maming saloba gisik - ka' tong tom'tomja. Me'gam Nongal : Che! Che! Maina indake grapa, ama? Na'a Nokman' demechik ong'a, na'a indake gisik be'grue mesokna nangja. Dimbri ; Ama, anga mai dosko dakmanjok, na'simang angko na'simangoniko chel'atna jotton ka'engara? (Grapa) Me'gam Nongal : Maiko ina? Nang'ko chel'atna jotton ka'enga? Na'a mikkangchi nokdang ba'ku dakjawama? Na'a pangnade ma'ming-paaming dongkamna [81J Dimbri Matgrik Toromi

Me'chik Dimbri Toromi Me'chik Me'gam Nongal Toromi Me'chik Dakmesoka III [Mesokani II] man'jawa. Changsade dingtang ong'na nangtelaigen. : Indake ong'ja Dimbri, do‘o bi'sarangara pangnajolna bitiptango dongaiama? Mandeba indaken dal'ahaode ma'ani-paani noko ka'saako wate dingtang nokdang ba'ku dnk ngna nangao ga'aka. : Ma'jong, anga nang'na angni ka'tongni kakket kattako aganenga, anga segipakon ra'jawa. Angni mikkango angni A'chik jatna dal'bea kamko ka'ani daito donga. Jatko jakgitel ong'atna jotton ka'na nanggen. Anga jatna an'chi on'gen. : Rani, Nokma iachipaknan re'baenga

aro un baksa saoba saobarang re'bapaenga. Na'song ma'ningsa ia biaponi jitangchengbo. Nokma na'songko ia biapo nikeode namnik- janaba donga. ; Ama, hai an'ching da'o re'naha indide. (Me'gam Nongal aro Dimbri ong'katanga) : (An'tangna agana) Anga chan- chiachim, tusia-bamsia gri, cha'a- ringa gri, gisik on'kange toposa [ 82 ] Dimbri Matgrik Noktna Toromi Me'chik ■jokma Toromi Me'chik Nokma Toromi Me'chik Dakmcsoka III [Mesokani II] ka'ani - iarang songsarna ka'paka-

niko jakgitel on ani ong'a ine. Indiba bao? Anga nokdang ba'ku dakgipa, songsarna ka'pakaoni chel'e dongeba, anga an'tangko jakgitel ine chanchinan man'jaenga. Uamang ma'ningsani kattarangko chanchie an'tangsa duk man'chaka. Indiba Dimbriara segipakon ra'jawa ine maina aganaha? () Gitel, ia mande jatni ka tongo na a jc skani bitchilko ge'songaha, uko pike galani mandeni jako bil dongama? Skani bitchirang be'enni ja dilrango gipani gimin mande tom tom dongaina man'ja. (Nokma Dejangpa napbaa) Abi, raniara ianon dnngachimbamo? ; Oe, ua lanon dongaciiini; aganode ua da'oan re baaigen. ; Rani baksa angni dingtangrnancha katta agangrikani donga. (lachi uachi re'jingjange) Haida na'a knaenggnok, Dumuryani rajaba Dimbriko bia ka'genna ine mande watataha. : Oe, knaade knaaha.

: (Rang' spec) Abi, ia pilak angni rasong kopalni gimin ong'engaha. : lana maina jajrengna nanga, Nokma? Indakede pilakchin ong'enga. 183 ] Dimbri Matgrik Nokma Me'gam Nongal Nokma Me'gam Nongal Nokma Me'gam Nongal Toromi Me'chik Dakmesoka III (Mesokani II] : Abi, na'ade bimchipe toposa ka'gipa ong'a; uni gimin ia a'songni manderangni cholon bewalrangko bang'akon ma'sijawa. la biani gimin badita gondogol ong'gen, uko agane bon'atna man jawa. (Me'gam Nongal napbataia)

Rani, nang'ni demechik Dimbrini bia namean matchotanggen ine angade ka'dongnan man'jaenga. : Maiko agangen, Nokma. Mingsa kattani giminde anga nang'na aganna somoian man'jaenga. : Uara mai katta? Aganboching rani? : Katta nambeade ong'ja Nokma, indiba nang'na agannan nanggen. : (Jagoka gita) Mai mancha ong'chong- mota aganboching? Maia indita namgija ong'na man'a. : Dimbride segipakon ra'jawana. Uni jatna kam ka'na nangani bang'beana. Segipa ra'odc jatna kam ka'na man'jawana, man'dikgenna. Angade ia bi'sani kattarangkode mamingkon ma'sina man'jaengaha. : Oe, Nokma, ia bi'sa angni mikkangon segipa ra'jawa, jatna kam ka'na nanggen inesa rake aganaia. [ 84 ] Dimbri Matgrik Nokma Me'gam

Non gal Nokma Toromi Me'chik Me'gam Nongal ... Oakmesoka III [Mesokani II] : Bebema? Indide da'o mai dakgnok? Jeba ong'bo, Dimbriko name skibo, aganbo. Maming kattani gamchat- aniko ning'tue ra'gija segipa ra'jawa inario cholijawa. (Dongsiksaka gita ina) Oh Gitel, ia anga maiko knaaha? : (Nokmani jakko rim e) Nokma, na'a indita dongsiksaknabc. Gitel Tatara Rabugao pangchakbo, ua pilakkon naljokatgen. Uan pilakkon tom'tomat- gen. : Rani, na'a chanchie nibo. Dimbrini gimin Dhobani raja aro Kuntaghatni rajaba mande watataha. Uamangni giseponiko saksakoba kusi ong'atna man'jaode uamang indinari watai- Jawa. Rani, nang'ni demcchik Dimbriara paako kratcha'atgenma?

Oh Gitel, anga mai papko dakmanjok, na'a angko janggiltikcngara. Angni ka'sabegipa demcchikba angko duk on'engaha. Angna da'o mai ong'gen? Angni ka'sabegipaonian angna mangkimaani sokbagen, iako anga jumangomangba chanchisona amja. (Me'gam Nongal jripjrip grapa) : Rani, na'a m.aiko dakenga? Maina grapenga? Abi, angni kopal rasongrang angko gualchipaha. A'gilsako duk chakna- san anga atchiaha. (Grapa) [ 85 ] Dimbri Matgrik Toromi Me'chik Me'gam Nongal Nokma Dimbri Dakmesoka III [Mesokani II] : An'tangko nom'boke mesoknabe. Gisikko rakatbo. Nokma ge'etode, chinga da'o nokningchi re'naha.

: Nokma, angni Dimbrini iano mai dos, aganboching? Uade da'oba nama narnja mamingkon ma'sikujaenga. Nokma, uko manengnabe, anga ma'gipa ong'e uko manengako chakchikna man jawa - mainaan ia bi'sa anggita dake rasong grigipa ma'gipani oko atchijok! (Grapa) : (Jakko rim'e) Rani, anga maikoba inmannaba donga, angko kema ka'bo. Anga maidakgipa mande ong pila! Anggita dake rasong grigipa me asa haida darangba dongja. Indita ringtobegipa chukoba anga bisi gitasa daknikman'aiaha. Hai rani, da'o an'ching nokdringchi re'naha. Mama Saljongba saliram salgiona re'chakatangengaha. (Rang'spee) Oh Saljong Salgra! Nang'na agre a'gilsako mamingan tangja, indiba nang'koba gadila pindape dimelatna man'aiama? Na'aba iani gimin duk ong'enga, mo? (Pilakan ong'katanga) (Dimbri napbataia)

(lachi uachi re'jingjange agana) Skangni somoi aro da'oni somoi bilongen dingtangaha! Salantian [ 86 ] Oimbri Matgrik Dakmesoka III [Mesokani II] janggi tangani salrang bilongen rakbarikrikengaha! Che, anga da'oba maina ianona indinari re'bamanjok ? Anga mamingkon namnikna man'jaengaha! (Rang'- spee) Anga angni jatna ka'saa. Indiba angni jat bilongen ong'sie brange janggi tang bagi pa rang ong' a. Tibetoni Bhutanona, Bhutanoni Nepal, Sikkim aro bon'kamao West Bengalni Maldaona sokbae iano Matgrik Sangkaldip A'chik jatko man e cha'dilaha, rasong mikkim gnangataha. Indiba ja'mano ua Hindu toromko ra'e Hindu ong’ aha. Aryanrangni toromko ra’e Hindu ong ani ja’manan, jc A’chikrang Aryanrangni toromko ra'e Hindu toromko ra'na jechakaha indiba ambi

atchuni manibagipa toromkon maniangna krcngangaha, raja Sangkaldip uamangko bilongen sinjetna aro saknaatna a'bacheng- aha. Bang'batan raja Sangkaldipna kene Aryan toromko ra'e Hindu pil'angaha. Hindu toromko ra'na jechakgipa A'chikrangko nokkol itna ong'jaoba a'songoniko rikgalna jotton ka aha. Indiba chakchike dongnuean janggi tangengachim. Raja Sangkaldipni A'chik jatni kosako sinjeta bilongbaroroaha. Hindu ong'ani ja'man an'tangba A'chik ku'siktangkon aganjaha aro [ 87 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dakmesoka III [Mesokani II] jean A'chik ku'sikko aganangkua ukon sasti on aha, pattoko chipataia- ha. Indake Hindu toromko ra'chakna jechakgipa A'chikrangko aro jattan- gni ku'sikko aganenggipa A'chik- rangko rokomari dake sinjetmitingon Afghanistanoni Afrasaiaf minggipa

saksa matgrik re'bae Sangkal- dipni rikgipa Gaur A'songko bobil dingeaha. A'bachengode raja Sangkaldipan amachim. Indiba baditaba changrang dakgrikani ja'man Afrasaiafan amchotaha. Raja Sangkaldip Tirhut a'briona katange dongnue dongeachim. Afrasaiaf aro uni chansokgija sipairang uko Tirhutona rikange so'ote galaha. A chikrang jattangni raja ong'oba jattangkon ong'ai ong'jai dake sinjetbeani gimin Sangkaldipna ia chango chakjaha. Ua A'chikskachiko maming dakchakaniko man'jaha. Indakesa Afrasaiaf uko altu-altu amaiaha. Unonin Gaur A'songni A'chikrang bilding bildang jebasi jejachi katna a'bachengaiaha. Gaur A'songoni katbae A'chikrang Koch Biharo dongeaha. Ia biapkon A'chik pagitchamrang “A' song Pattari Chiga Suunchi” ine mingbaaha. Uni ja'manba A'chikrang rokomari champengarangko man'oba re'aniko

dontongjaha. Indake uamang “A' song Saora Chiga Timbora”-ona katbaaha. [ 88 ] Dimbri Matgrik Toromi Me'chik Dimbri Toromi Me'chik Dakmesoka lit [Mesokani II] la biapan Rongpur ong'a. Unoniba “A' song rake kenana, Chiga ringna pa'jana” ua a'songko wate katbataia- ha. Unoniba uamang “A'song Neng'gitu Chiga Ncng'chibing”-ona katbaaha. la biapan Dhubri ong'a. la Dhubrio songdong a'chamitingon anga atchia ine agana. Dhubrio atchiani giminan angni bimingko Dhumbri ba Dimbri mingana. Dhubrio bang'a bilsirang dongna on'jani gimin da'o dongenggipa Manas Rikamona re bae dongeaha. Da'o anga dal'aha. Uni gimin anga angni jatna kam ka'na nanggen.

Angni jatko jokatna nanggen. (Toromi Me'chik napbaa) : Dimbri na'a iano saksan maiko dakenga? Nang'ko nang ma da'sio- nin sandiengachim. Hai, re'bo hai! : Ma'jong, anga da'ode dal'aha bilsokaha. Anga chanchina changa- ha. Anga da'o ma'ni kuri ka'bako dongani somoi ong'jaha. Angni jatna miksongani bilongen bang'bea. Na'a angna ka'donganiko on'bo. Angna pattibo jedakode anga angni A'chik jatna dakchakangna man gen. : Na'a maiko inenga, Dimbri? Jatna chanchigiparang matgrik aro seng'gipa rakgiparang donga. Na'a [ 89 ] Oimbri Matgrik Dimbri Toromi Me'chik Dimbri Toromi Me'chik Dimbri

Toromi Me'chik Dimbri Oakmcsoka III [Mesokani II] uamangko ga'bengbate jatna maiko chanchigen? (Toromi Me'chikchipak niate) Ma'jong, na'a da'oba ianona banoni re'bataijok? ; Maina! Re'bana nangjachimma? : (I a chi uachiko niwingwange) Mairongpila! Ma'jong, anga mingsa aiao inmaiigipa Jumangko nika- chim, uko knajokode na'a aiao inmangen. : Maia jumang, aganboching? ; Badiaba mandir nokdringo mongnal bilial balsani kosako anga asonge dongmanenga. Indake asonge dongmitingon saksa silbea me'chik jako mongnal bibalko ra'e angni mikkango chadengaha aro ua chadengarian - “O angde, na'a angko salam ka'bo, anga nang'ni ma'gipa gitan ong'a” ine inaha.

: Uni ja' man? ; Anga uko salam ka'aha. Uni ja' man ua indake inaha -“Nibo, angde, je nomil ia jelbegipa jatna an'tang janggiko on'kanga, uni biming maming saloba gimajawa. Uko chasong chasongna ia jatni [ 90 ] Dimbri Matgrik Toromi Me'chik Dimbri Toromi Me'chik Dimbri Toromi Me'chik Dimbri Dakmesoka III [Mesokani II] manderang ma'ringanggen, gisik ra'anggen. Angaba ia jatonin ong'a. Angni bimingko Citing minga. Na'a jattangni namgnina an'tangko on'kangode, nang'ni biming ia jatoni maming saloba gimajawa, chasong

chasongnan nangni bimingko mingsing-minggamanggen. Na'a jattangna janggi on'kangnan atchiaha. Ian nama somoi, ka'angbo”. : Uni ja'man? Uni ja'man maiko inaha? ; Uh! Ma'jong, na'a angko rim'bo. Angni be'en gimik an'tangtang an'jrimengaha. : (Dimbriko rim'e) Hai, an'ching ianoni nokdringchi re'naha. lano donge maming lap dongja. Nibo, angde, angna je kattarangko na'a aganaha, ua kattarangko na'a maming saloba darangnaba agannabe. (Salgisako ka'sroka doka dam'ani) : Ah! Badita knatoa, ua knabo, ma'jong! : Bao! Angade mamingko knaan knajaenga. : Bebema, ma'jong? Knajaengama, badita knatobea ku'rang. Gisik ka'tong ka'suang dakpila. [ 91 ] Dimbri Matgrik Toromi

Me'chik Dakmesoka III [Mesokani II] : Hai, angde, iano donge an'chingni maming lap ong'jaengaha. Na'a ianoni ta'rake re'na jotton ka'bo. Sal somoi namja. (Sakgnian ong'katanga) *** [ 92 ] MESOKANira Manas Chibimani rikam, A'chik Song [Rikampa aro baditaba sak nirokgiparang napbaa] Rikampa ; Rakman! Skanggipa Nirokgipa : (Jak chopjole) Maina, matgrik, ge'etbo. Rikampa : Nibo, na'simang pilakan bilongen simsake dongbo. Da'al darangkoba ia songo napna on'nabe. Skanggipa Nirokgipa : Nang'ni ge'eta gitan ong'china. Nang'ni ge'etana agre, sawa ka'donggen ia songo napna. Rikampa : Aro nibo, Dhobani rajani mande

watatgiparangni jamdapo maiba dake maiba gondogolrangko knana man'ode bikan angna kobor on'bo. Skanggipa Nirokgipa : Nang'ni ge'eta gitan ong'china. [ 93 ] Dimbri Matgrik Rikampa Gnigipa Nirokgipa : Skanggipa Nirokgipa ; Gnigipa Nirokgipa : Skanggipa Nirokgipa : Dakmesoka III [Mesokani III] (lachi uachi nie an'tangna agana) la Dhubrioni re'bagipa peruara bilongen chalakkigipa ong'a. Indita mikbokrakgipa, gipinna namgijako chanchiaigipa dakait saoba dongama? Indiba Bijnini manderang baksa bakbakan nangrimani, meliani a'selko anga mamingkon ma'sina

man'jaha. (Chanchia gita dake) Uamangni nangrim-meliani maiba ning'tua a'sel dongchongmotna nanga. Ong'jaode indake bik dake uamangni nangrimani maming ja'pangkon angade nikjaenga. (Ongkatanga) (Mittinoni dakgrikani doka dam'a) Namengama, Rakman — Mai, mai ong'a? Nang'o anga mingsa kattako sing'na skenga; nang'kode knaman'enga na'a pangnan an'chingni matgrik Rikampa baksasa dongpaengana; Nokmani songsarni gimin na'a jegita aganna changgen, ma'sia, indake darangba ma'sijawa. kotokrangko simsake aro mikrake dongchina ge'etgen. Na'a amchak- jaenga ine nikode bakan kobor on'ataibo, anga rang'san angni matgrikrangko rime chaangaigen; na'a mamingnaba jajrengna nangja. krajawa, uko Chitmangona watatai- gen. (Ong'katanga) : (An'tangna agana) Maiko miksonge chi mangnangko ko'na, auna miksuna on jaenga, mamingkon ma'sina man'ja. sinjetaniko on'enga? : Nang'ni iarangni gimin sing'ani ong ja. Nang'ni ka'gniko gualnabe. Nang'ni ka'gniara mai, u'iama? dongtimna nanggnok. Da ode walaha. Walode darangba chi ko'na, auna re'bajawa. : Name simsake dongtimbo. Maiba ong'gija koborrangko man'soode, knaode sasti man'gen. Sasti uan gitok sottongani sasti. na'tok-na'bat rim'na on'jaenga. Na'simang ia chibimaona re'banabe- ha. (Ginje aro Rinjeni gimbeni chiko pakdrae gala) : Hai sari, ia seng'a dakgipa rori bipako rim'srangna. Senapati Sipai Nokma Chigatpa Dakmesoka V [Mesokani III] tangchi nikna man'aha. Me'chik- rangan indake ka'donggiparang ong'ode, me'asarang aiao! Chanchiatnan kenmana (Kosakchiko nigitdoe) O Gitel! Na'asa da'al ia ka'grak nomil sakgnini jakoniko smgko jokataha; mikkangchi indaka a'sel baksa chagrongatjachina nang'o bi'a. Nang'ko hajal hajal salam, Gitel. (Salam ka'e ong'katanga) : Senapati, da'al walon Garorangni dongenggipa biapko changduulbo aro uamangni Nokma Dejangpako man'ode angona rim e ra'babo. lamang indinari ia biaponi katjawa.

Indiba maming koti aro nosto ka'kunabe. Nokma Dejangpako mangmang rim e ra'baaibo. Da al walon. : Nang'ni ge'eta gitan ong'china. Da'al walni gisepon Nokma Dejangpako rim'e ra'bagen. Mandeni gitokko sottongata ja'man ua mande maidake ga dekdeke sia, uarangko nie rona bilongen namnikgipa aro suk ong'gipa mande ong'a anga. dakgrikna chingsoode aro warachak- soode; chingara maiko dakskabo? : Mamingkoba dakna nangja; angna bakan kobor on'nataibo. Maiko dakna nanga, anga nang'na dingtang ramako mesokataigen. kakket ong'e bimchipangbo. Anga da'o on'tisa neng'takekuna. tom'tomako namnikgipa; ka'donggipa - indiba sontolgipa; kengijagipa - [ 153 ] Dimbri Matgrik Sipai Pilakan Senapati Pilakan Senapati Dakmesoka V [Mesokani III] indiba darangkoba ra'bigijagipa aro bilak-wa'sagipa - indiba chakchik- rakgipa jat ong'a. Uamang angni ku'pattiani- ko ra'chakjachim. Uni giminsa uamangni gamjinrangko ra'seke, so'ote mikkangchi re'mikkangbana nangaha. Da'o nang'ni pal. Nang'ni

mikkango do'ga ge'gni oa donga. Na'a namnikode gong' ode angni kattako manie chingko sokachakna nang- gen. Indiba mingsa kattani gimin anga nang'o moPmolna skengachim; ua kattaara, anga angni manderangko ia Manas [158J Dimbri Matgrik _ Dakmesoka V [Mesokani III] rikamoniko Songdu nalsachi rimangna am'engaha. Songdu

chibimako batsotangna gita angna maiba cholko dake on'ode anga chasong gimik nang'ko mittel- begenchim. Uamang an'tangtangni nok-jamrangko aro jikko-deko wate jasnimang angming re'rikpae dakgrike ra'seke roenga. Uamangni cha'a ringanirangko angan on'enga. na'simangni jam nokoniko skatang gamjinrangko chimonge matchu aro matma garirango gatgen. Uni ja' man, nang'ni songjinmaniko sak ritchagit- tammang cholina gita dakgipa me'chikrangko angni tambuona [ 159 ] Oimbri Matgrik Dakmesoka V (Mesokani tiq watatna nanggen - bi'sa ba'gijagipa banji, randi aro segnang ong'oba ong'aigen. Indiba nibo, uamang silsilna nanggen aro buchuma ba bi'sa ong'na man'jawa. Bilsi chi'chetoni bilsi kolatchichet. Na'a angna silsila me'chik ritcha gittamko on'bo, nang'na anga Songduko batsotang a man'na gita te'rik pang ritchagittamko on'gen. Ma'siahakon- ba? (Dejangpa jrip dongaia - ia changoba ua aganchakna man'ja). Nokma Chigatpa : Na'a jajrengnabe, uamangko chinga ching baksa rimangpa'jawa. Sakanti silsila me'chik walsana sakbri

sakbonga sipairangko kusi ong'ate pringon noktangchi re'angpilna man'aigen. Walsamangmangnasan! Bas! (Jenjulko rim'e dongenggipa sipaiko miksonge) Sipai! Dejangpani jakni-ja'ani jenjulrangko okatbo engatbo. (Dejangpako kaarangko enga) Da'ode na'a jajrenggija nang'ni songjinmatangchi re'ange nang'ni manderang baksa grong- grikebo ku'mongebo. Re'angbo. (Dejangpa skoko denggoke re'angna ine ja'ku de'angon, do'gachol sambaona sokon, ki'sangchipakni) O, knaangboching. Mingsa kattako aganna gualengachim. Da'al walna [ 160 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dakmesoka V (Mesokani III] angni tambuona saksa sila me'chikko watatbo. Waljatchio. Gisik ra'bo, ua me'chik angko kusi ong'atna man'jaode knal pringon anga dingtang dabianiko dabiaigen. Angming bang'e chalakki dake

mesoknabe. Knajokkonba? (Dejangpa kratcha'a amchakjae denggoke ong'katanga) Nina, uamang angni kattako maniama manija, manijaode bnek- pile tingangsranggen. Ha....! Ha....! Ha....! Angan Manas aro Songdu chibimani chigatrangko nirokgipa “Nokma Chigatpa” ong'a. Angan Nokma Chigatpa. Angni ku'watako man'gija darangba chi ko'na, auna- miksuna, na tok-na'batnaba chiona ong'katna man'jawa. Ha....! Ha — ! Ha....! Nina, da'al walo uamang maiko chanchibaa. (Ong'katanga) [ 161 ] MESOKANIIV Manas chibimani rikam, A'chik song (Dejangpa aro uni retrang uko ja'rike napbaa) Dejangpa Rikampa Dejangpa Rasong kopalni kasaninggija

saknaaniko on'achi mande jensalo onbatgipa kratcha'gnikoba ku'racha- ke ra'chakna draatako man'a, unon ua gringo chipchanga man'gipa singho gita saknaako man e mamingko chanchina changgijagipa gita ong'a. Jeba ong'na nangode ong'aigen, sina nangode siaigen, indiba indake one dabianiko, jatko chonnikaniko aro kratcha'gni kamna ku'rachakbana nangjachim. (Rikampani kattako knaman'e retrang Dejangpako ong'arek ong'jarek kattarangchi saitoka) Na'simang angko jegitaba inbo, indiba angni kattako ka'sapae [ 162 ] Oimbri Matgrik Dakmesoka V (Mesokani IV] knachengpabo. Anga ua somoio gisiko indake chanchie ra achim, je Nokma Chigatpani dabianirang jegitaba ka'saninggijani aro krat cha'gnini ong'china — ku'rachak- jaode an'chingni songjinma gopram

gita chacha ong genchirn. Nokan- tinikon ra sekdragenchirn. Sakanti me'chikan draako man'genchim aro me'asarangko so'ote galtokang- genchim. Na'simang chanchienga, anga indinari angni songjinmana aro angni jatna namgija kragijako ku'rachakbaaha. Chong' motan, anga gualaniko dakbanaba donga. Mandea gualaniko dakronga. Angaba be'en an'chini mandcsan ong'ani gimin gualako daknaba donga ba gualakon dakmanaha. Uni gimin anga da'o, na'simangni kusina Nokma ong'ani- ko watengaha. Na'simang na'simang - ni namnikgipa matgrikko Nokma songna man'a. Nokma songaniko man'a ja'man ua Nokma gital, gital dake ua ka'saninggijagipa matburing baksa pilakni namnika gita songgigrikna man'a. Darongpa : (Ka'onangprete) Indita ruutani ja'man, gital dake maiba chan- chianiko jako ra'gitikade an'tangni jara-burbok ong'anikosa parakenga.

Nokma Songanio maming saloba A'chik Jatni Itihaso walsani gisepo [ 163 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dejangpa Jachingpa Dimbri Dejangpa : Dakmesoka V [Mesokani IVJ songa dongkuja. la kamko na'an a'bachengahani gimin, naan bon'atbo. la songjinmani ritcha- gittam silsila me'chikrangko na'an mesoke on'bo. : Maina? A'chik jato jat chigni chanani donga. Na'simang angni kattako ra'chakode, indide an'tangtangni jatonilco me'chik sak 25 dake tik ka'babo - Jemangan an'tangtangni me'chik ong'e dongani cholonko jatni namgnina on'kanggen. Na'a chingni Nokma, jatko dilgipa ong'a. Nang'ni kattako chinga manie ra'aha. Indiba jatprakan me'chik sak 25 prak dake knalsa am'e rimbagen

- da'al walni gimin ua matburingni tambuona badia rasong gnanggipa me'chik re'anggen - uni gimin na'an aganchengbo. (Tom'ram nokningoni do'gacholo neuate) Mande ra'na krabegipa Nokma, angko tik ka'e donaha. Na'simang mamingna jajrengnabe. (Pilakni mikronan do'gachol sambao chadenge donggipa, Nokmani saksa kamkam bilsi chi'chetgipa demechik- chipakkosa aiao inmane niattoka, uanchim chasongni silbegipa bimangni Dimbri). Na'a basako re'baaha? Sawa? Sawa? Sawa ua an'tangko on'kangenggipa matgrik me'chikara? [ 164 ] Dimbri Matgrik Dimbri Me'gam Nongal Dimbri Pilak . Dakmesoka V [Mesokani IV]

: Anga baba, anga Dimbri, nang demechik, anga angni A chik Jatna an'tangko on'kangenga; maina, on'kangani nokonian ong'bachengna nanga. An'tang on'kangchengesa gipinna on'kangani gimin skibo. (Pilakan aiao inmane ua silbegipa aro Jatna an'tangko on'kangenggipa Nokman' demechik, Dimbri matgrik- ko nitate donga) : (Rang'san grape Dimbrini sambachi re'ange) Na'a maiko ku'watjok, Dimbri? Nang'ko anga indake nosto ong'na on'jawa. Na'a nang'ni ku'watako ra'pilbo; nang'ko anga watna man'jawa (Grapa). : Ama, na'a angni gimin mamingkoba chanchinabe. Nokma ong'ani gimin Jatna babani badita daito donga, uni demechikniba ugitan apsan. Baba jeko chu'sokatna man'jawa uko anga, uni demechikgipa, chu'sokat- gen. Darangba on'kanggipa dong- jaode dolsa jat jakgitel ong'na amja. Anga angni jatna ka'saa - uni gimin

angni jatni namgnina anga an'tang- kon on'kanggen. Angni ka'sabegipa A'chik Jat tangbangangchina! Uni jatni namgnina indake on'kangani gimin chasong chasongnan A'chik Jatni ma'ambio sonani oikorchi uni biming see dongangchina. dongangchina. Dimbri Matgrik Tangbangchina. Jinma : Dimbri Matgrik Tangbangchina! Da'al angming turam am'pakpana me'chik watatjaha. Uko anga knalan - : (Nokma Chigatpani tambuni do'gacholo neuate) Nokma, Manas rikamoni sakgni re'baa; uamang nang'ko grongna am'enga. ong'katanga) : (Ba'ra pingruako kinggilake Nokma Chigatpani sambachi re'ange) Ge'etbo Nokma, anga nang'na maiko dakna nanga? ; (Dimbrini silako nike aiao inmane an'tangna agana) Bah! Chong' mot jajongan da'al angni tambuona napbaaha. (Parake, Dimbrini be en bimangko rim'roke) Anga nang'ni chadambe bimangni silako ringna sikbeengaha. Na'a indita silbegen ine anga jumangomangba chanchija- chim, O! Angni jabitchim ka'tongni jarambong, na'a angni ka'tongko teng'suatbo. : Ong'aigen Nokma, anga nang'onan re'baaha, nang'nian ong'aha. [ 171 ] AGANCHOTANI I an baditaba chasong skangni katta bng'a. Do'orang, matburingrang uno mandeni ku'sikchi katta agangrikjachim, maina, ia chanchichipe golpo banaie aganaigipa katta ong ja. Dimbri aro Nokma Chigatpa, ia A'chik Jatni ma'ambi aganritingbaanio mingsa “his- torical” katta chong'mot ong'a - saksara A'chik Me'chik aro sakgipinara Rori Me'asa ong'a. A'chikrangni ka'tongo uamangni kattarang mohor su'a gita dake da'oba dongenga. Sal, jaa aro bilsiko parake uamangko mesokna man'jaoba, uamang dongchongmotachim ine jajagijaan aganna man'gen. Chinani “Great Wall” -ko haida ua somoio a'bachengan dongkuja, indiba A'chik Jat ua somoion North- East jolo sokbaaha, songdonga'chana nama biapko sandie-am'e iachi uachi re'jojoaha. Mande jatni a'gilsako skia man'banio

A'chik Jatni maming on'gilani dongjaoba, dakgrikani bida, gama ge'anio, aski tanorirangni bidingo chanchianioba chu'ongani dongjaoba, [ 172 ] Oimbri Matgrik Aganchotani toromo aro Tantraism’-ni bidingode A'chikrangni on'gilaniko jechakna man jawa. lamangchikon mandeni itihaso North-East jolo ‘Tantraism’ toromko man'rika ine aganna man'gen. Da'ode Tantraism’ Hindurangni toromoba ge'sa bak ong'aha. Tantraismni mongsonggipa biapde KAMAKHYA’ ong'a A'chikrangni chengo songdonga'cha- bagipa biapara Tsangpoh Chibimani Salgro- Salgipeng jolrangan ong'achim ine u'igiparang agana. la Tsangpoh Chibimani rikamo songdonga'chabaani giminan iamangko “Tsangma” ine mingbaachim ine chanchichipe aganna man'a. lamang chong‘motde Tsangpoh Chibimani paktangtango songdonga'cha- giparang ‘Tsangma* ba ‘A'chikrangan' ong'a. Tsangma ine iano jatkosa miksonga. Tsangmarangni gisepo “Ma'rak”-gipa ba ‘rakgipa’-kosa ‘Ma'rak ba Marak’ ine mingbaakon ine chanchiman'a. Baditaba

chasong uamang iachi uachi tom'tom pangkamgipa songdongram biapko am'e re'jojoe brange roachim. Songdongram A'song: Bon'kamao uamang Tsongdu Rikeimni Salgipengchipak Garhurachal ba Garhur Paharo dongkamna ku'mikchetaha. la a'songni bimingan da'o A'chik Jatni songdongenggipa “Garo Hills” ong'a. A'bri- buringrara daka aro uni [ 173 ] Dimbri Matgrik Aganchotani ja'rekrangara a' sal gnanggipa biap ong'a. la biapni ro'ara haida 200 km aro gipengara 150 km mang ong'naba donga. Janggi tangna neng'skime mitamrang Tripura, Bangladesh, West Bengal, Assam aro Nagalandrangonaba biap am'angaha gipangaha. Noro Mande Dema Risi A'chikrangni ka'tongo mingsa ba ge'sa gualna man'gijagipa birning ong'a. Indiba ia Noro Mande Dema Risini gimin A'chikrangni ma'ambi agananio tale aganani dongjaoba, darangan ia Noro Mande Dema Risini bimingko ma'sitoka u'itoka. Indiba, ia Noro Mande Dema Risiara sawa manchachim, uni gimin name tale agananiko

maming history kitaprangoba nikna man'rongja. Mitam ki'tap segiparang, Noro Mande Dema Risiko A'chik Jatni Pagitcham ba ‘Pro- genitor’ ine mesokaha. Noro Mande Dema Risi A'chik Jatni Pagitcham ong'bebeoba, baditaba chasong iachi uachi re'jojoe brange so'sojengjeng ong'e janggi tangbana nangani gimin, uni bimingko gisik ra'kuengoba uan A'chik Jatni Pagitcham ong'achim ine ukode gisik ra'sokatjaha. Aryanrangni Toromni ki'tap Maha- bharata-o (Bana Parva), Pandavarangni buringo dongnue dongna nangani somoio, sakgni Risirangni bimingko mesokaniko nikna man' a [174J Dimbri Matgrik Aganchotant - uamangni bimingara Lemosh aro Dhaumya ong a. Mahabharata-o Dhaumya Risiko Pandavairangni Kamal ine agananiba donga. Dhaumya Risian Pandavarangko Kamakhya- ona re'dilbaachim ineba Mahabharata-o ag£inani donga. A'chik Jatni aganritingbaanio Noro Mande Dema Risi ine ma'sibagipa risiara ia Pandavarangni Kamal Dhaumyaan ong'na

nanga. Pandavarangni Kamal Dhaumya Risian A'chik Jatni Pagitcham ong'ode A chikrang Pandavarang baksa maiba dake bakdil nangachim ba melia nangrimani dongachim gita daknikman'a. Meihabharatani Dhaumya Risian A'chikrangni Noro Mande Dema Risi ine ma'sibagipa ‘Risi’ ong'chongmotna nanga. Dhaumya risikon A chikrang Dema risi ine mingbaaha ine bebera'anio aro agananio maming gualani ong'jawa. A'chikrang songdonga'c hana ine nama biapko am'e re'jojoe brangroroe iachi uachi katbrange biap namako am'roroe dongmi- tingon, dingtang dingtang a'songni rajarang baksa chagrongarangko an ching A'chikrangni ma'ambi agnnritingbaaoniko knana aro u'ie ra'na man' a. Indake chagrongarangni gisepo Rori Sadepa Nokma Chigatpa baksa gronggrikanian A'chikrcingna gualna man'gija- gipa chagrongani ong'aha. Nokma Chigatpa saksaka'saninggijagipa, an'chi ringsolrakgipa mandeskalchim . 11751 Dimbri Matgrik Aganchotani Indiba ia Nokma Chigatpaara sawa

m£uichachim, uko maming history-rangoba mesokaniko nikna man ja. Indiba ia Nokma ChigatpaEin A'chikrangni ma'ambi aganriting- baanio saksa gualna aro gelna man'gijagipa mande ong'a. Uko gale A'chikrangni ma'ambi aganani meaning gitaba chu'sokgipa ong'na man'ja. A'chikrang 3ino-Tibeto a'songgita jokbagipa chibima dilgnini rikamrangosa songdonga'chabagiparang ong'achim ine ma'ambi u'igiparangni agananiko nikna man'a. Ua chibima dilgnini bimingrangaraTsangpo aro Huwangho ong'a. Historyo ‘Huwangho’ chibimakode “China’s Sorrow” ine minga. Maiba u'isokgijagipa a'selni gimin ua biaponi katbana nangon, A'chik pagitchamrang dingtang dingtang chasongo eiro dingtang dingtang biap gitasa re'badilbaachim ine pagitchamrangni ma'ambi aganbaaoniko ma'sina man'a. Indaken pagitchamrang dingtang dingtang dilgiparangni bimingrangko minga. Salaram aro Salgipengchipeik Tsongdu chibimako batsotna dakenggipa A'chik pagitchamrang Ron Sadepa Nokma Chigatpa baksa gronggrikaha. A'chikremg ia Nokma Chigatpa beiksa hedda maibani a'selo melina nangrimna man'jachim,

ong'jaoba, A'chikrangni ka' donga aro bilak- wa'saako nike, mikkangchina kenchake, maibarango pa'sike, A'chikreingni bilgrimitingo, A'chikrangko ua biaponiko rikgalna budi [176] Dimbri Matgrik Aganchotani dakaha. Ua budi dakanio A'chik Nomil Dimbri, gipin jatni mikbokani sikar ong'aha.Dimbriko on'kangbaen A'chik pagitcham ma'gitcham- rang, ua ka'namgijagipa aro ka saninggijagipa Rori Sadepa Nokma Chigatpani jakoni jokbaaha. Jattangko chonnikarangko nike Dimbriba chakchikna man'jae, mandeni bimango matburing gisikni ua mandeko, budi dakskae, ka'samike, chu pekate so'otaha. Bebera'tojaoba indaken ong'chongmotachim ine bebera'na nangao ga'aka. Indake maiba a'selrang ong jaode, A'chikrang Tsongduko chobatbaani ja'manba ua nalsani rajarang A'chikrangko maina bobil dingbaachim ine darang chanchirakgipa A'chikrangni gisiko sing a nakataigen. Nalsaona bobil dake dingbagiparamgni gisepo Ron Sadepa Nokma Chigatpani bimingkode mingtaiako knana man ja. lani orto, Nokma Chigatpako Dimbri

so'otaha ine u'ina man'ani ja'mansa ua nalsani rajairang A'chikreingko (Dimbrini ma'kringko) mangkimaatna ine ka'kim chae Tsongdu nalsaonaba bobil dingbaachim. Rori Sadepa Nokma Chigatpa sijaode uaba Tsongdu nalsaona A'chikrangko bobil dingbapagenchim. Indiba ua bobilrang A'chikrangko mangkim- aatna man'angjaha, bikpile uamangsa A'chikrangna kene katangsdaha. Indiba dukni katta ian, A'chik Jatni salgisakni ching'begipa aski rongsa, bobilrangni [ 177 ] Dimbri Matgrik Aganchotani chri - bra watanio joksekjaha; uko baditaba chrirang uni chelo, janggilo nangeaha aro unon ua gitilgopaha, A'chik Jatna ma'ringe Manas rikamon ua ga'akgropaha. Dimbri Matgrik Tsongdu nalsachian sibaaha. Dimbriko ka'tongo gisik ra'esan A'chik Jat Tsongduko batsotna te'rik chap kagipao gatokaha. Me'gam Nongalde demechiknr' grapean sibokpilachim. Tsongduko chobatna A'chikrang salsni walsni nangaha. Nokma Chigatpako so'otaha ne knae Koch Biharni raja bilongen aiao inmanaha aro rang'san Dhobani raja baksa

ku'monge A'chikrangko bobil dingna Tsongdu nalsaonaba rikba-chabataiaha. Uamangko niksoe A'chik matgrikrang rang'san mi cha'ako dongale, mil'am sepi ra'bildange - me'a- me'chik nangrime bobilko warachaksona krimkro ku'cholsan ong'soaha. Dongdipgija salgittam walgittam chri bra watosa, mil am sepi ra'bildange chingsoosa Raja Bihari eiro Dhobani raja A'chik matgrikrangni ka'dongako nike, amchakjana kenchake katangpil'aiaha. Neng'take ia biapo misal cha'mitingo bobilrang baksa dakgrikna nangani gimin ia dg.kgrikram biapkon “Misal Cha'ram” ine mingaha. Misal Cha'ramoni bang'gija chel'aona jitange A'chikrang “A' song Neng'abat Chiga Neng'chibat” minggipa biapo dongeaha. Raja [ 178 ] DimbriMatgrik _ Aganchotan- Bihari aro Bijnini raja bolgni nangrime, adita sipairangko rimbitbae ia biaponaba A'chik- rangko bobil dingna rikbataiaha. A'chik matgrikraingni gisepo Chusinpa, Chuganpa, Olbin Kongdep, Baucheng Basuchengmang janggi jama galpile bobilko waracliaksoaha aro

ia dakgrikanio me'asarang baksa me'chik- rangba rimol sa'am pangpike, sok kanako dongale, mil'am sepi chakpile bilongen dakgrikpaeiha. Dolgninian bilongen an' chi pari ong'aha aro bang'en manderang siaha. Uni ja'man, Dimbrina ma'ringe aro dakgrikao sigipa matgrikrangna skime; adita salrangna chu cheke, wanti toke, ringe-cha'e salsni walsni ua biapo kalimkuaha. la dakgrikanio A'chik rangan bobilrangko amchepataha aro ia biapkon “Garo Mari Topla Khawa”-ine da'oba rr aigkuenga. Uni ja'man uamang salaramchi Tsongdu rikam joljol re'ange Ildek chisam Uolgomao, jekon A'chikrang “Dol jikjek jikjek, Gong mejek mejek, Roetara” ine mingachim, ua biapo re'ange dongeaha. Uanoniba mitamrang kosakchi doangkuaha aro bon'kamao Gua-a'te (Da'oni Guwahati) jolo, Saljongpatra, Rongdo'gachol, jeo Gaantini Ringringram Chiga Chironggini jinjinram a'song Kamagiriona sokeaha. Uni ja'mano, mitamrang Bokoni salgipeng jolo donggipa a'bri, Matcha Melaramo [ 179 ] Dimbri Matgrik Aganchotani

dongeaha. la biapoba uamang tom tom dongna man'jani gimin, saliramchipak mikkange antangtangni re'bagimin ja'kolko re'angtaiaha. Adita A chik dilgiparang Rong'mikseram Tangka Dakram aro Me'tongbol A'brio songdongeaha. Mitam A'chikrang Sambol Me'dikku, Amak Honda Turamo, A'song Dul Dokramo re'ange dongeaha. Indaken A'chikrang priprae dingtang dingtang biaprangona aro da'o A'chikrangni song- donga'chaenggipani ning'tugipa biap- rangonaba gipangaha jelangaha. Dimbrini ma'gipa Me'gam Nongal aro uni ma'kringrang haida da'oni Nongal jolona re'bae songdonga'chaachim aro maiba mingsa obosta (incident) ong'aonisa, ua biapko Me'gam Nongalni bimingchi ‘Nongal Bibra’ ine mingbaakon ine chanchiman'a. Ong jaode, ia ‘Nongal’ katta indinari maming ja'ting rikge gri chong'bana man'aijawa. North-East jolo songdonga'chagipa Tribalrangni gisepo A'chikrangan gnigipa jelbatgiparang ong'gen ine angni ripeng saksa angna aganachim. Uni kattako anga bang' a bebera'na man'jachim. Indiba jensalo

an'tangan a'songni iachi uachi re'na nangao ga'akaha aro gipin gipin a'songrangoba (State) A'chik songrang donga ine nikbaaha, unonisa anga angni jattangnijelako u'ina aro bebera'na [ 180 ] Dimbri Matgrik Aganchotani man'aha. Chong'motan A'chik jat jelbegipa jat ma'sa ong'chongmota, indiba indake jelgipa jatni maming ma'ambi ripingani dongja. Aganritingbagipa ma'ambirangniba maming j a' ting rikge donggija gita daknikman'aia. Assam, Tripura, Nagaland, West Bengal, Arunachal Pradesh aro Bangladeshoba A'chikrang donga ine ma'sina man'on, jattangna ka'pakman'ata aro ua pilak A'chikrangko apsan biapo songdongate, a'gilsakni manderangna A'chikrangba jelgipa aro bilakgipa jat ma'sa ine parakna man'genchim ine chanchiman'a. Indake jelbegipa jatniara ma'ambi dongama? Dongchongmota. Indiba indake sing'anina aganchakaniko gipinchiko man na ka'donggija, an'ching an'tangtangonikon man'a ama, indiba sakanti A'chikan on'tisa ‘Home work’ ka'na nangangkugen. Jattangna, A'doktangna aro

Ku'siktangna ka'saani, on'kangani sakanti A chikni ka'tong ning'oni an'tangtang nabana nanggen. Unosa, Somoi Nawangni Okningo A'chikraingni gimaae dongenggipa ma'ambiko, jatni rasong mikkimko, bilak-wa'saaniko, changa sapaniko, pilcikkon janerao nika gita jrojrange nikna aro A'chik Jatni chu'gimik Ma'ambiko bikote a'gilsakni manderangna rasong gnange mesokna man' gen ine anga ka'donga. The plots are wonderful and the concept is extraordinary. I applaud the fertile imagination you have manifested in your writing. The dialogue construction with rich vocabulary is terrific. Comparisons and use of Figures of Speech are enlightening, but on the heavy side. Too much use of comparisons sometimes takes a toll on the reader's patience. Otherwise, dialogues are lucid and catchy. Please take care during proof reading. Too many mistakes can mar the reader’s enjoyment. Wish you all the very Best 13 / 7/08 (Abi Re'nangma) B. K. Sangma
